title: Analyst - Presales
description:
**Job Description – Presales Executive / Analyst (RFP Management)**
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**Experience:**
2–3 Years
  
  
**Department:**
Presales / Solutions Consulting
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Head – Presales
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Presales Executive with 2–3 years of experience in RFP/RFI management, bid coordination, and proposal development. The individual will work closely with Sales, Product, Solutions, Security, Legal, Finance and Customer Success teams to create compelling, high-quality responses for enterprise and government tenders across geographies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end RFP, RFI, RFQ, and tender response processes.
* Review bid requirements and prepare compliance matrices and response plans.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to gather technical, commercial, security, and product inputs.
* Develop, customise, and maintain proposal content, response repositories, and knowledge libraries.
* Prepare executive summaries, solution descriptions, implementation approaches, and customer-specific responses.
* Track proposal timelines, submission schedules, and approval workflows.
* Support sales teams with presentations, capability documents, and customer questionnaires.
* Maintain a repository of standard responses, certifications, customer references, and supporting documents.
* Ensure proposal quality, consistency, and compliance with customer requirements.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Technology, or a related field.
* 2–3 years of experience in Presales, Bid Management, Proposal Writing, or RFP Management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and customer-facing skills.
* Strong attention to detail and document management capabilities.
* Experience working with enterprise SaaS in the LMS solution space is preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple bids and deadlines simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and collaboration tools.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience responding to enterprise and government tenders.
* Understanding of cloud/SaaS platforms and enterprise software solutions.
* Familiarity with security, compliance, and procurement questionnaires.
* Experience using proposal management or knowledge management tools.

**Key Success Metrics**

* Timely submission of RFP/RFI responses.
* Proposal quality and compliance scores.
* Win-rate contribution through high-quality bid responses.
* Accuracy and maintenance of proposal knowledge repositories.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and response turnaround time.

title: Forward Deployment Architect
description:
**About the Role:**

As a Forward Deployment Architect, you will serve as a hands-on senior technical architect on the Applied AI Engineering team, owning the end-to-end design and delivery of AI-driven business transformation projects.

You'll work closely with pre-sales teams to scope technical integration and implementation strategies, translating business requirements into architectural solutions. Once opportunities move to post-sales, you'll own the detailed technical designs from original scoping documents and drive execution including hands-on coding to build proofs-of-concept, custom integrations, and solution prototypes that validate technical feasibility.

As the technical owner of the customer relationship, you'll partner cross-collaboratively to ensure successful delivery. Your role spans from understanding domain-specific customer needs to architecting scalable, agent-based AI solutions using DevRev's platform\*\*, with direct involvement in implementing key technical components and debugging complex integration challenges.

This position requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture expertise, AI solution design, hands-on development skills, customer empathy, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll act as the connective tissue between pre-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams, bringing our AI capabilities to life for real-world business impact.

**What You'll Do:**

* Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers
* Design & Deploy AI Agents: Build, configure, and launch intelligent agents using the DevRev platform to solve real customer problems.
* Integrate Systems: Connect AI agents with external platforms (e.g., CRMs, APIs, databases) for seamless workflow automation.
* Optimize Performance: Tune prompts, logic, and agent configurations for accuracy, reliability, and scalability.
* Own Requirements: Partner with customers to deeply understand their needs and translate them into technical agent specifications.
* Prototype & Iterate: Lead live demos, build rapid proof-of-concepts, and refine solutions through customer feedback.
* Lead Execution: Define project plans, align internal teams, and ensure timely delivery of deployments.
* Advise Customers: Act as a trusted technical advisor on AI agent architecture, performance, and long-term scalability.

**What You Bring:**

* Experience: 7+ years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or technical consulting. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms, (Nice to have: Go).
* Applied AI Knowledge: Large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* System Integration: Comfortable integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and event/data pipelines.
* Data-Driven Mindset: Use A/B testing, telemetry, and metrics to guide decisions and drive improvements.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to both engineers and business stakeholders.
* Customer Empathy: A bias for action and a relentless focus on solving problems for customers.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Advanced degrees or certifications in AI/architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, SAFe) are a plus.
* **Travel: This role requires approximately 80% travel, primarily for customer implementations, technical workshops and on-site engagements.**

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.

title: Proposal Associate
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
Our global team continue to our focus on building relationships and delighting our clients (90% of our business is repeat business). In return we have opportunities to work on unique and exciting projects, and a stable platform upon which to develop your career, and a diverse workforce culture where we truly encourage you to bring your whole self to every aspect of your work.
  
  
By working together in international teams and with different perspectives, we gain the experience that is our collective strength. In Jacobs, every day is a chance to make the world a better place - let's design your career with us!
  
  

* As Proposal Associate you will provide ownership of the end-to-end opportunity, working with Subject Matter Experts to develop value propositions that position to win work.
* You own the quality and presentation of our submissions and work with the teams to determine the best approach and style of response.
* The working environment is fast paced, and it is essential to have the ability to balance technical and commercial differentiation to support the Sales Lead in presenting the perfect balance that wins projects which fit our vision.
* You are to be effective at bringing the ideas of others to market; have good judgment about which ideas and suggestions could work; and be able to coordinate the work winning and creative process of others as part of an opportunity team either in a lead or coordinator capacity.
* Working with a high degree of autonomy, you have excellent communication skills and are comfortable with managing priorities and deadlines.
* Highly developed soft skills relating to facilitation, conflict resolution, time management, and instilling an inclusive culture within the opportunity team are all of value.
* Assertiveness and influencing skills ensure your success working with stakeholders in this high-pressured environment. In addition, an ability to work and train team members to use Microsoft, CRM Salesforce, SharePoint, and InDesign are all considered advantageous.
* This is the perfect role for someone who enjoys leading proposal sessions and developing outstanding content.
* Jacobs’ Relationship-Based Sales methodology -
* Champion and lead the implementation of our Relationship-Based Sales (RBS) methodology - especially in Middle Game and End Game for Tier 1 & 2 pursuits. - Apply best practice RBS process to pursuits.
* Work with Sales Leads and Capture Managers/ Operations to develop B&P estimate, gain approval, regularly monitor B&P spending, and report any significant variances of the specific opportunities.
* SOX and ISO certification compliance for the entire proposal is adhered too as it related to the RBS/sales process as part of the opportunity close-out.
* Particularly in relation to governance and recording of Bid/No Bid decisions, Green Reviews, and Sales to Operations handover.
* Develop understanding in review of client terms & conditions, pricing strategies and Jacobs’ financial metrics.
* Work within core Sales Systems and Tools (e.g. CSP, SharePoint and Knowledge Centre). Sales and Marketing Materials & Knowledge
* Develop and maintain qualification materials including project descriptions, experience matrices/overviews, safety and quality statistics, capability statements. Work with Operations to capture and develop performance proofs and client testimonials relevant to the opportunity/proposals.
* Collaborate with Sales Lead and Capture Manager/ Operations in developing distinctive value propositions that enhance our customers’ competitive position relating to Opening Game.
* Share sales materials, information, knowledge, and best practices with other Sales Operations team members company wide.
* Jacobs’ Brand Representative
* Lead by example, be proactive in ensuring health and safety of opportunity team throughout.
* Be an advocate of our BeyondZero culture and company values.
* Lead compliance with our Corporate Identity Program and client confidentiality requirements for all sales documents relating to the opportunity/proposals.
* Provide support to Global Sales e.g., timely preparation of press releases, providing input to our Annual Report, and support of Global Sales initiatives as appropriate.
* Champion Jacobs brand, including working within Brand Guidelines for visual identity and brand voice.
* Opening Game/ Market & Account Strategy - Partner with Market Sales Director, Head of Sector and S&T in key Opening Game activities, e.g. client, competitor & market research, development of Market Roadmaps.
* Support Sales Leads and Client Account Managers (CAMs) in key Opening Game activities, e.g. client, competitor and market research, development of documented Core Client Strategies, participation in 101s, development of Executive Summaries and White Papers.
* For the industry sectors pursued by your team, develop an understanding of our corporate, regional, and office qualifications including technical, managerial, commercial and competitive strengths that differentiate Jacobs in the marketplace.
* Leverage global network to identify & convey Jacobs’ unique capabilities & resources. Collaborate with S&T and Outside Sales to develop Capability Statements and White Papers. -
* Client Go / No Go and Account Reviews and Focus Windows as required.
* Conduct/ facilitate 101 meetings for key accounts, in partnership with outside Sales. Middle Game (Opportunities)
* Organise, direct, and motivate a multidiscipline opportunity team to develop Middle Game win plans and strategic sales actions and deliverables, or stimulate the assignment of teams for assigned opportunities.
* Actively initiate and partner with sales leads, CAMs and Capture Managers to develop and implement Middle Game action plan, e.g. document due diligence in project brief, develop Win Plan (G to VP), SWOT analysis, and Executive Summary, conduct initiate Go/No Go and strategy review, and identify delivery team.
* Actively work with Sales and Operations to develop, implement and monitor Middle Game actions, using Client Success Platform (CSP) [Salesforce] & SharePoint. - Conduct Opportunity Go/No Go and strategy reviews in CSP. - Develop Win Plan (Gaps to Value Proposition), SWOT analysis, and Executive Summary.
* Identify execution/delivery teams, coach and support them in the win strategy.
* Challenge concepts, solutions and assumptions in constructive ways to truly differentiate and develop unique value propositions. End Game (Bids & Proposals)
* Arrange or lead the planning and of all elements of End Game, e.g. analyse client request, develop response plan (B&P budget, response team, compliance check-list, response outline, schedule), initiate Go/No Go, conduct Pink Team, conduct kick-off meeting, manage and work with team to develop response sections, refine Executive Summary, conduct in-progress reviews, prepare Red Team package, incorporate Red Team input, schedule Pricing Reviews, ensure on-time delivery of response
* Champion use of Client Success Platform (CSP) for approvals & linked SharePoint for End Game document collaboration.
* Analyse client requests & develop response plan (B&P budget, response team, compliance checklist, writing plan, response outline, schedule).
* When leading an opportunity; initiate Opportunity Bid/No-Bid meetings, conduct Pink Teams, conduct kick-off meetings and record all approvals in CSP, or else check compliance of opportunities assigned to you.
* When leading an opportunity, manage and work with team to develop response sections, especially value propositions and Executive Summaries or else check compliance of opportunities.
* When leading an opportunity conduct in-progress reviews, prepare Red Team package, incorporate Red Team input, Schedule Pricing Reviews. Conduct and record approvals in CSP or else check compliance of opportunities /proposals.
* Ensure on-time delivery of any response within the assigned opportunity. - Support or check if the opportunity close out processes after submission including collaboration with knowledge management is completed.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or any relevant Degree with around 9+ years of experience. \* Solution-selling strategy development
* Writing skills
* Marketing/sales coordination
* Facilitation, influencing and group process
* Opportunity/ bid / proposal management
* Business acumen
* Time management and task coordination
* Influencing stakeholders

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Scent Solutions Executive, India
description:

Are you passionate about exploring fragrance creation and developing the scents of tomorrow?
  
  
IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.
  
  
Harnessing the full emotional power of scent, driven by pioneering creativity, science, consumer expertise and a mindful approach to fragrance design.
  
  
The role is based in Mumbai, India (
*onsite*
role). Be part of a creative, collaborative, and impact-driven team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.

* Translate customer briefs into suitable fragrance recommendations based on application, olfactive direction, performance and price.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Chemistry, Fragrance, Cosmetic Science or related discipline.

* Excellent olfactive expertise (selected candidates may need to complete an olfactory smelling test).
* Demonstrate customer focus, organisation, initiative, commercial awareness, digital confidence, and a willingness to develop olfactive and application knowledge.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

**How Would You Stand Out?**

* Curious approach and enjoyment of challenging projects.
* Ability to articulate creative decisions, balance creativity and cost.
* Experience in leveraging fragrance banks for cross-category initiatives.

**Why Choose Us?**

* Inclusive and diverse workplace culture.
* Collaborative and growth-oriented team environment.
* Structured learning and development programs and opportunities.

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.
  
  
Visit IFF.com/careers/workplace-diversity-and-inclusion to learn more

title: International Business Executive - SM
description:
Job Description: International Business Executive
  
  
Company: MedPrime Technologies
  
  
Department: Sales & Marketing
  
  
Position: International Business Executive
  
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
  
Reporting To: Manager – International Business
  
  
**Job Summary**
MedPrime Technologies is looking for an ambitious and detail-oriented International Business Executive to support global business expansion, international sales, and cross-border commercial operations. The candidate will be responsible for identifying international business opportunities, generating leads, managing client relationships, preparing quotations, coordinating export documentation and logistics, and supporting visa and travel documentation processes.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, an understanding of international trade operations, and the ability to coordinate with clients, distributors, logistics partners, and internal teams across different countries.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* International Business Development

Identify and generate new international business leads and sales opportunities.
  
  
Research overseas markets, distributors, and potential channel partners.
  
  
Support onboarding and relationship management of international clients.
  
  
Assist in developing strategies to expand the company's global presence.
  
  

* International Sales & Client Management

Support B2B sales activities, prepare sales pitches, and follow up with prospective clients.
  
  
Maintain regular communication with international customers and business partners.
  
  
Manage client inquiries and support customer retention activities.
  
  

* Pricing & Quotation Management

Prepare international quotations based on regional pricing requirements.
  
  
Coordinate discount approvals and pricing requests.
  
  
Ensure competitive pricing while maintaining company profit margins.
  
  

* Export Documentation & Logistics

Coordinate international order fulfillment and shipping activities.
  
  
Prepare and manage export documentation, customs paperwork, and compliance certificates.
  
  
Coordinate with freight forwarders and shipping partners in accordance with applicable Incoterms.
  
  

* Visa & Travel Coordination

Coordinate visa processing, corporate invitation letters, and travel documentation for international clients, partners, and company employees.
  
  
Ensure documentation is accurate and aligned with applicable immigration requirements.
  
  

* Financial Coordination

Track international payment schedules and follow up on outstanding invoices.
  
  
Coordinate with the finance team regarding international transactions.
  
  
Assist in monitoring currency-related and credit risks.
  
  

* International Market Research

Track global market trends, regional tariffs, and international trade regulations.
  
  
Share market insights to support sales strategies and commercial decisions.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in International Business, Logistics, Global Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field.
  
  
MBA is an added advantage.
  
  
1–2 years of experience in sales support, export coordination, international trade operations, or corporate travel administration.
  
  
Relevant internships may also be considered.
  
  
Basic understanding of Incoterms 2020, shipping documentation, international B2B transactions, and visa processing requirements.
  
  
Skills & Competencies
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  
  
Strong coordination, negotiation, and client relationship management skills.
  
  
Proficiency in MS Excel and CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
  
  
Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
  
  
Ability to work with international clients and multicultural teams.
  
  
Knowledge of a second language is an advantage.
  
  
Willingness to travel internationally occasionally for trade shows, training, or client meetings.
  
  
**Benefits**
Flexible work schedule
  
  
Health insurance
  
  
Leave encashment
  
  
Provident Fund (PF)

title: Senior Specialist - Architecture
description:
**Role Description**
**Role Summary**

* Customer-facing technical owner for opportunities and implementations.
* Convert media, data and AI problems into secure, scalable and production-ready solutions.
* Own architecture from discovery and pilot through engineering, deployment and handover.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead discovery with customer business, product, data, AI, security and engineering teams.
* Define use cases, target workflows, architecture, integrations, data flows, non-functional requirements and roadmaps.
* Preserve a reusable, model-agnostic core while allowing controlled customer configuration.
* Assess data readiness, model fit, integration effort, cost, assumptions and delivery risks.
* Support proposals and SOWs, and remain accountable through architecture reviews and production sign-off.

AI, Platform & Cloud Architecture
  
  

* Apply deep knowledge of video/multimodal AI, computer vision, speech AI, LLMs, embeddings, vector search, reranking, RAG, recommendations and agentic workflows.
* Turn model outputs into reliable decisions using metadata, ontology, business rules, confidence thresholds, ranking, temporal logic, human review and feedback.
* Define model evaluation across accuracy, precision, recall, relevance, temporal grounding, latency, throughput, explainability and cost.
* Design AI pipelines for ingestion, preprocessing, retrieval, inference, validation, feedback and continuous evaluation.
* Architect APIs, microservices, event-driven services, workflow engines, vector databases, model serving and enterprise integrations.
* Integrate with MAM/DAM, CMS, media supply chain, data platforms, OTT/player, AdTech, localization and observability systems.
* Define Hyperscaler deployment, Kubernetes/container patterns, security, resilience, observability, DR and cost controls.
* Shape MLOps for model/prompt versioning, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, rollback, lineage and cost tracking.

**Hands-On & Collaboration**

* Create or review prototypes, APIs, notebooks, model evaluations, architecture diagrams and deployment designs.
* Inspect payloads, logs, traces, model outputs and performance metrics to resolve issues with engineering teams.
* Guide AI/ML, Data, Backend, Frontend, DevOps and QA teams on architecture and quality standards.
* Partner closely with the Product Lead and Engineering Head on reusable capabilities and implementation sequencing.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 9–10 years of technology experience, including Building and shipping AI Saas products / solutions , solution architecture, enterprise integration or cloud-native engineering ownership.
* At least 3–4 years of substantive AI/ML, data, automation or intelligent-platform architecture experience.
* Proven customer-facing experience leading discovery workshops, technical reviews and complex stakeholder discussions.
* Ownership of at least one solution from discovery or presales through pilot, engineering, deployment and handover.
* Strong knowledge of distributed systems, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, data pipelines, CI/CD, observability and security.
* Hands-on proficiency in Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to validate integrations and prototypes.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and container/Kubernetes deployments.
* Strong communication, estimation, problem structuring, risk management and architecture-documentation skills.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline.

**Preferred Media Experience**

* Media & Entertainment, OTT/streaming, broadcast, studios, MAM/DAM, AdTech, localization, live sports, QoE or video-processing workflows.

title: Manager, Strategic Consulting
description:

world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong organizational and analytical skills.
* Core Management Consulting Experience, Research & Analytics Experience preferably in Real Estate.

title: Estimation Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Watchdog Security is a leading system integration and critical infrastructure solutions provider, specializing in data centres, smart buildings, fire and life safety, and integrated security solutions across India. The company partners with enterprises, hyperscale environments, commercial infrastructure, and mission-critical facilities to design, engineer, implement, and maintain reliable and scalable technology ecosystems. With strong expertise in high-uptime infrastructure, Watchdog Security delivers integrated systems that ensure continuity, safety, security, efficiency, and performance. Its capabilities span data centre ELV, fire alarm and suppression, CCTV and access control, building management systems, structured cabling, building automation, environmental monitoring, and advanced command and control solutions. Focused on secure, intelligent, and resilient infrastructure, Watchdog Security supports India’s rapidly evolving digital and data centre ecosystem.
  
**Role Description**
The Estimation Engineer is responsible for preparing accurate cost estimates and technical proposals for data centre, smart infrastructure, fire and life safety, and integrated security projects. On a day-to-day basis, this role reviews drawings and specifications, analyzes bills of quantities, and identifies material, labor, and subcontracting requirements for ELV, BMS, security, and related systems. The Estimation Engineer collaborates with sales, design, and project teams to develop competitive bids, value-engineered solutions, and detailed scope clarifications aligned with client requirements and standards. The role includes coordinating with vendors for pricing, validating technical compliance, supporting pre-sales presentations, and updating estimation databases and templates. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong estimation and costing skills for ELV, BMS, fire and life safety, security, and data centre infrastructure projects, including quantity take-offs and pricing analysis.
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting engineering drawings, technical specifications, and tender documents, with the ability to prepare clear bills of quantities and scope summaries.
* Knowledge of relevant industry standards and codes for fire alarm, gas suppression, CCTV, access control, structured cabling, and building automation systems.
* Experience coordinating with vendors and subcontractors for technical and commercial quotations, and comparing offers to support competitive bid preparation.
* Solid skills in MS Excel and other estimation or project tools; familiarity with AutoCAD or similar design software is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or related engineering discipline; prior experience in system integration or critical infrastructure projects is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and capacity to work to deadlines on multiple concurrent tenders.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and interact professionally with clients.

title: Contract & Proposal - CRO & FSP
description:
Tech Observer is seeking a motivated, detail-oriented, and results-driven Contract & Proposal professional to support the growth of our U.S. business across the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and clinical research sectors.

This role will primarily focus on contract coordination, proposal development, RFI/RFP responses, maintain passthrough trackers and sales support, while also contributing to business development, lead generation, client relationship management, and market research.

The successful candidate will work in UK/US shift and coordinate with Business Development, Legal, Finance, Recruiting, and Clinical Operations teams to prepare client-facing proposals, coordinate contract documentation, track opportunities, and support the sales process from initial prospect engagement through contract execution and handover to delivery teams.

The role requires strong communication, research, coordination, and organizational skills, along with an interest in understanding the CRO, FSP, clinical research, and staffing business.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Contract Coordination & Management

* Coordinate the preparation, review, tracking, and execution of client contracts and related documentation.
* Assist with the preparation and coordination of Master Services Agreements (MSAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), staffing agreements, and other commercial documents.
* Liaise with internal stakeholders, including Business Development, Legal, Finance, and Operations, to facilitate timely contract reviews and approvals.
* Maintain a centralized repository of contracts, amendments, renewals, pricing schedules, and related documents.
* Track contract status, pending approvals, expiration dates, renewals, and outstanding documentation.
* Follow up with internal teams and clients to ensure contracts progress through the approval and signature process.
* Support the onboarding of new clients by coordinating required vendor registration forms, compliance documents, insurance certificates, and other client-specific requirements.
* Maintain accurate records of contractual commitments, commercial terms, and documentation, escalating discrepancies or potential risks to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Assist with contract-related reporting and provide regular updates on pending agreements and execution timelines.

2. Proposal Development & RFI/RFP Management

* Coordinate and support the preparation of Requests for Information (RFIs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), proposals, capability presentations, and other client-facing documents.
* Gather technical, operational, financial, and commercial inputs from relevant internal teams to develop complete and accurate responses.
* Work with Clinical Operations, Medical Writing, Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Recruiting, and Project Management teams to collect service-specific information.
* Maintain and update standard proposal templates, company capability decks, case studies, service descriptions, and other business development collateral.
* Customize proposals and presentations based on client requirements, service offerings, project scope, and business opportunities.
* Coordinate pricing requests, rate cards, resource requirements, assumptions, and commercial inputs with the relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure proposals and RFI/RFP submissions meet client requirements, formatting guidelines, submission deadlines, and internal quality standards.
* Track proposal status, submission timelines, client feedback, follow-up activities, and outcomes.
* Support the preparation of presentations for client meetings, capabilities discussions, and business development events.
* Maintain a repository of previously submitted proposals, client questionnaires, RFP responses, and supporting documentation for future reference.
* Assist with the transition of awarded opportunities to the relevant delivery teams, ensuring that the agreed scope, timelines, and client expectations are communicated clearly.

3. Business Development & Lead Generation

* Support business growth by identifying and researching prospective clients across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and CRO organizations.
* Develop and maintain target-account lists and a qualified pipeline of potential clients for CRO, FSP, FSO, contract staffing, permanent staffing, and related services.
* Conduct prospect research and outbound outreach through email, LinkedIn, phone calls, industry databases, networking, and conferences.
* Identify key decision-makers within target organizations, including Clinical Operations, Procurement, R&D, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, HR/Talent Acquisition, Outsourcing, and Vendor Management.
* Support the qualification of leads by gathering information on client needs, project requirements, outsourcing plans, timelines, and decision-making processes.
* Schedule introductory meetings between prospective clients and senior Business Development or technical teams.
* Conduct regular follow-ups with prospects to maintain engagement and help move opportunities through the sales pipeline.
* Assist Business Development Managers and Directors in preparing for client meetings by researching organizations, understanding their service requirements, and compiling relevant company information.
* Maintain accurate records of prospects, client interactions, opportunities, meeting outcomes, and next steps in the CRM system.
* Identify opportunities to cross-sell or introduce additional company services to existing and prospective clients.

4. Client Relationship & Sales Support

* Build and maintain professional relationships with prospective and existing clients through timely communication and follow-up.
* Respond to client inquiries and coordinate internally to obtain the required information, documentation, and commercial inputs.
* Support client onboarding, vendor registration, due diligence questionnaires, and supplier qualification processes.
* Coordinate with internal teams to address client requests related to capabilities, pricing, contracts, resource availability, and service delivery.
* Track client requirements and ensure relevant stakeholders are informed of pending actions and deadlines.
* Assist with client presentations, capability discussions, business reviews, and follow-up communications.
* Support the handover of new business opportunities to delivery and operational teams following award or contract execution.

5. Market Research & Business Intelligence

* Research pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, clinical development pipelines, therapeutic areas, outsourcing trends, and potential business opportunities.
* Monitor industry developments, competitor activities, market trends, and emerging client requirements relevant to the company's service offerings.
* Identify upcoming RFPs, vendor qualification opportunities, strategic partnerships, and potential outsourcing engagements.
* Research relevant industry conferences, pharmaceutical networking events, and business development forums.
* Maintain and regularly update target-account databases, prospect lists, competitor information, and market intelligence.
* Prepare research summaries and reports to support account planning, sales strategies, and business development initiatives.

6. Reporting & Sales Operations

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of contracts, proposals, client opportunities, and business development activities.
* Prepare periodic reports on proposal submissions, contract execution status, pipeline activity, pending approvals, and follow-up actions.
* Track key deadlines and coordinate with stakeholders to ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Support improvements in proposal templates, contract tracking processes, document management, and sales operations workflows.
* Assist in maintaining CRM data quality and ensuring business development records are complete and accurate.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Healthcare, or a related field.
* 3-8 years of experience in proposal coordination, contract administration, business development, sales support, account management, inside sales, recruiting, or a similar client-facing or coordination role.
* Experience supporting RFI/RFP responses, preparing proposals, coordinating commercial documentation, or managing contracts is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare professional client-facing documents and correspondence.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple proposals, contracts, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Good research and analytical skills, including the ability to gather information from multiple sources and summarize findings effectively.
* Comfortable with professional email communication, LinkedIn outreach, follow-ups, and outbound prospecting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Familiarity with CRM systems such as Salesforce or HubSpot is preferred.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at different organizational levels.
* A proactive approach to problem-solving, follow-up, and task ownership.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams.

Preferred Experience

* Experience working with a CRO, FSP, pharmaceutical company, biotechnology organization, medical device company, or healthcare staffing business.
* Familiarity with clinical research services, including Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, Clinical Data Management, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Writing, and Pharmacovigilance.
* Exposure to MSAs, SOWs, NDAs, pricing schedules, vendor onboarding, and client procurement processes.
* Experience coordinating RFI/RFP submissions, proposal development, capability presentations, or vendor qualification documentation.
* Understanding of contract staffing, FSP/FSO models, and professional services agreements.
* Comfortable with night shift or Uk shift

title: Technical Consultant-Wind, BESS & Renewable Energy Advisory
description:
**Joining Arup**
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. Arup is a UK-headquartered independent firm of designers, planners, engineers, consultants, and technical specialists offering a wide range of professional services. With 90 offices in 35 countries, their 19,000+ staff make a positive difference in the world through their work.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a senior renewable energy professional with combined expertise in wind resource assessment, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and technical due diligence including Lender’s Technical Advisor (LTA), Independent Engineer and Owner’s Engineer roles. The successful candidate will support and lead advisory assignments across wind, solar, hybrid and storage projects, including Round-the-Clock (RTC), Firm and Dispatchable Renewable Energy (FDRE) schemes and Standalone BESS systems including projects under the Viability Gap Funding schemes. The role requires strong analytical capability, practical understanding of project development and bankability, and confidence in working with investors, developers and lenders
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
This role focuses on leading wind resource assessments and energy yield studies using industry-standard tools, covering wind data analysis, flow modelling, wake assessments, micro-siting, and layout optimisation. The position is also responsible for preparing energy production forecasts, uncertainty assessments, P50/P90 estimates, and reviewing third-party technical reports for project bankability, investment, and financing decisions. It further involves integrating and optimising Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) for renewable and hybrid energy projects.
  
  
The role supports technical due diligence, construction monitoring, grid code compliance reviews, and risk assessments for wind, solar, and storage projects. Responsibilities include evaluating project designs, contracts, warranties, financial model assumptions, and operational strategies while preparing high-quality reports for investors and lenders. The position also requires client engagement, multidisciplinary coordination, business development support, and providing technical guidance on energy transition solutions, including green hydrogen and Power-to-X studies.
  
  
**Is this role right for you? If you have**

* 8-10 years of experience in renewable energy, technical advisory, project development, consultancy, IPP, or OEM environments
* Strong expertise in wind resource assessment and energy yield analysis, with hands-on experience in WindPro and WAsP.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Energy, Renewable Energy or a related engineering discipline
* Experience in BESS integration, sizing, and optimisation for hybrid, RTC, and FDRE renewable energy projects.
* Proven background in technical due diligence, lender advisory, independent engineering, or transaction advisory assignments.
* Good understanding of wind, solar, and energy storage project lifecycles, project risks, contracts, grid integration, and bankability.
* Strong analytical, reporting, client management, and stakeholder coordination skills, with the ability to manage projects independently
* Exposure to Python-based energy modelling, green hydrogen, Power-to-X projects, and experience in the Indian or international renewable energy market would be an added advantage.

Not ready to apply just yet, or have a few questions? Contact (Nisha.Gulati-nisha.gulati@arup.com). Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.

We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector. Core benefits include Provident Fund contribution, NPS option, Mediclaim cover (incl. family), Term Life and Accident Insurance, Employee Assistance Prog. scheme for the family to safeguard your physical and mental wellbeing. In addition, all permanent employees are eligible for the Global Profit Share scheme. Subject to scheme rules employees can receive two Profit Share payments per year, which are dependent on the firm’s financial performance.
  
  
**Different people, shared values.**
At Arup, we believe when talented people collaborate, great things are possible. Arup hires people with proven skills and open minds. We are taking deliberate action to create an inclusive culture that is grounded in our purpose to shape a better world.
  
  
At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. Our internal employee networks - BAME, Culture, Disability, LGBTQ+ and Women - provide a space for you to express your views and to make a positive difference - discover more about life at Arup here.
  
  
At Arup, we are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application.
  
  
At Arup, we appreciate that everyone’s circumstances are different and having the freedom to flex the way we work is essential to our wellbeing. If flexibility matters to you let us know when you apply, and we will discuss how this could work in your role.
  
  
**What happens next?**

Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process

title: Solutions Consultant
description:
Nemetschek India Private Limited is a global organization and with a legacy of over half a century. It is a public company listed on MDAX and TecDAX (Germany) stock exchanges. The Nemetschek Group is a forerunner of digital transformation in the AEC/O (Architecture, Engineering, Construction & Operations) industry and covers the entire life cycle of construction and infrastructure projects. With intelligent software solutions, we lead our customers into the future of digitalization. By using our solutions customers can plan, build, manage, and operate buildings and infrastructure projects.

Nemetschek India is looking for a strong Technical Sales Specialist / Senior Solution Consultant to support enterprise growth across the AEC and infrastructure ecosystem in India. This is an individual contributor role focused on partnering with enterprise sales on strategic pursuits, shaping solution value for customers, and helping drive adoption of digital workflows and platforms at scale.

The role combines deep domain understanding in AEC, BIM, and digital construction with strong customer-facing consulting and commercial support skills. The successful candidate will work directly with sales teams, customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to translate business needs into compelling technical solutions, demonstrations, workshops, proposals, and proof points.

Strategic sales support

• Partner with enterprise sales teams on key pursuits, strategic accounts, and large opportunities.

• Support discovery conversations with CXOs, CTOs, CIOs, Digital Heads, Design Heads, and project stakeholders to understand business priorities and digital transformation goals.

• Contribute to large enterprise sales cycles including RFPs, bids, proposals, business cases, and executive presentations.

Solutioning and value articulation

• Translate customer business challenges into solution concepts, technical recommendations, and ROI-oriented value propositions.

• Shape solution architecture and workflow positioning across design, collaboration, construction, and asset lifecycle use cases.

• Lead product demonstrations, proof of value discussions, workshops, and customer use case sessions tailored to account needs.

• Work closely with account teams to articulate how Nemetschek solutions address customer pain points, workflow gaps, and digital maturity goals.

Domain and technical consulting

• Bring strong understanding of AEC, BIM, digital delivery, and construction workflows into customer engagements.

• Hands-on experience on tools like Allplan, Archicad, Vectorworks, SDS/2 etc.

• Advise customers on adoption approaches for digital workflows, data-driven collaboration, cloud-enabled processes, and connected project environments.

Market and customer development

• Identify whitespace opportunities across infrastructure, real estate, EPC, design, and government sectors, and support account teams in developing solution-led opportunities.

• Collaborate with marketing on customer events, industry campaigns, workshops, and thought-leadership engagements.

• Help build reference customers, success stories, and repeatable value narratives from field engagements.

Partner and ecosystem collaboration

• Work with system integrators, consultants, channel partners, and technology partners on joint opportunities and solution positioning.

• Support technical enablement of partners where required, including solution use cases, demonstrations, and technical messaging.

• Collaborate with customer success and services teams to help ensure smooth transition from sales to adoption

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Experience

• 10-15 years of experience in technical sales, pre-sales, solution consulting, or solution engineering roles.

• Strong exposure to AEC, BIM, infrastructure, engineering, or construction technology environments and software like Allplan,SDS/2, Archicad, Vector works etc

• Experience in customer-facing solution presentations, workshops, and consultative technical selling.

Skills and capabilities

• Strong understanding of AEC workflows, BIM-led collaboration, and digital transformation challenges across the project lifecycle.

• Ability to connect customer business goals with technical solution value and adoption outcomes. • Strong presentation, demonstration, and workshop facilitation skills.

• Comfort engaging both executive stakeholders and detailed technical users.

• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration capability.

• Familiarity with platforms and technologies such as BIM, digital twins, project controls, cloud SaaS, interoperability, and workflow integration.

Preferred background

• Experience with enterprise software vendors serving AEC, infrastructure, engineering, or construction customers.

• Exposure to consultative selling in complex multi-stakeholder environments.

• Experience working with strategic accounts, ecosystem partners, and enterprise bid cycles.

WHAT WE OFFER

• A young, dynamic, and innovation-oriented environment.

• A wide variety of projects within different industries.

• A very open and informal culture where knowledge sharing, and employee development are key. • Room for personal initiative, development, and growth.

title: Fire Fighting (Mechanical) Project Estimation Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Fire Fighting (Mechanical) Project Estimation Engineer**

**Department: Mechanical Tendering & Pre-Sales**

**Reports To: Head of Fire Project Estimation / Tendering Manager**

**Employment Type: Full-time**

**Job Summary**

**The Fire Fighting (Mechanical) Project Estimation Engineer focuses strictly on the mechanical aspects of fire protection. You will evaluate tender documents, review architectural/MEP drawings, and develop precise cost estimations for fluid-based and gas-based fire suppression systems. This role demands sharp attention to detail to build accurate Bills of Quantities (BOQ), run complex hydraulic calculations, and ensure all bids comply perfectly with relevant safety codes.**

**Key Responsibilities & Duties**

**1. Mechanical Material Take-Off & Costing**

**• Review engineering layouts to quantify piping networks, valves, fittings, and heavy equipment.**

**• Prepare comprehensive BOQs for fire hydrant systems, wet/dry sprinkler systems, and pre-action setups.**

**• Estimate structural requirements including pipe supports, hangers, seismic bracing, and anti-corrosive coatings.**

**• Factor in complex installation expenses such as hot work, structural welding, pipe threading, grooving, and testing/commissioning phases.**

**• Track steel and raw metal market indices to adjust pricing for piping materials dynamically.**

**2. Hydraulic Calculations & Design Validation**

**• Perform advanced hydraulic calculations using software like Elite Fire, SprinkCAD, or Pipenet.**

**• Size mechanical infrastructure accurately, including pipe diameters, fire pump capacities (GPM/Head), and water storage tank volumes.**

**• Validate heavy machinery placement, ensuring fire pump house configurations and diesel/electric pump assemblies meet hydraulic demands.**

**• Propose value engineering alternatives to reduce material weights or optimization of routing without failing pressure tests or safety margins**

**3. Special Suppression Systems Costing**

**• Design and cost gas suppression networks including FM-200, Novec 1230, Inergen, and CO₂ systems.**

**• Estimate clean agent requirements by calculating exact room volumes and leakage limits.**

**• Quantify specialized systems such as foam-water deluges for high-hazard zones and kitchen hood wet chemical suppression.**

**4. Tendering & Vendor Management**

**• Float detailed RFQs to pipe manufacturers, valve suppliers, and specialized pump vendors.**

**• Build technical compliance matrices to compare vendor offers against strict client specifications.**

**• Draft comprehensive technical submittals outlining system operational limits, pump curves, and material data sheets.**

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**• Education: Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.**

**• Experience: 3 to 6 years of pure mechanical estimation experience within the fire protection industry.**

**• Regulatory Frameworks: Strong command over NFPA standards (NFPA 11, 13, 14, 15, 20, 24, and 2001) alongside local building codes or civil defence regulations.**

**• Software Toolkit: Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD (2D), MS Excel, Bluebeam, and Elite Fire / SprinkCAD. Experience reviewing Revit/BIM models is preferred.**

**• Hardware & Component Mastery: In-depth knowledge of seamless/ERW piping, groove/thread fittings, deluge valves, pressure reducing valves (PRVs), backflow preventers, and diesel/electric fire pump controllers.**

**Salary Package**
: 6 to 5 LPA

**Benefits :**

24 Paid Leaves. (start after probation - Monthly 2 leave)

Health Insurance. (start after probation)

12 to 13 days National Holidays.

description:

MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Mumbai for our hybrid working model.
  
  
As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* Ideally 8 to 11 years of related experience in a customer facing role, with 5 to 7 years of experience in pre-sales with enterprise software
* Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity
* Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem
* Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
* Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership
* Ability to strategize with sales teams and provide recommendations on how to drive a multi-threaded account strategy, aligning other MongoDB and ecosystem resources to move towards a mutually beneficial account plan
* The ability to travel up to 25%
* A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

You may also have
  
  

* Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers

* Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects

* Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message
* A MongoDB Certification
* A Cloud Provider Certification

What you do at MongoDB
  
  
In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:
  
  

* Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB
* Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders
* Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the sales team to drive account success through account planning, opportunity prioritization/qualification and pipeline generation strategy, while taking ownership of the technical aspects (including but not limited to technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentations, sizing and documentation)

* Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction
* Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members
* Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends

What you will learn
  
  
MongoDB Product Suite Mastery
  
  

* Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
* Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
* Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly

Market-Relevant Technologies
  
  

* Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
* Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes

Modern Architecture Design
  
  

* Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security
* Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space

Sales Techniques and Soft Skills
  
  

* Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding
* Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling

Industry Insights
  
  

* Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

title: Field Application Manager – Robotics

Location for this opening: Mumbai Factory

Field Application Manager – Robotics

Lead field applications at the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. It is a priceless opportunity to shape robotics in India.

Own applications, demos and commissioning for cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree.

The Role

You will lead Luna's Field Application Engineers and own the technical success of every robotics project across our Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree range: industrial robots and cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoid robots and quadruped robot dogs. You will be the senior technical partner for key accounts and the sales team, and set the standards our field team works to.

Must Have

• BE/BTech in Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical or Automation Engineering.

• 6–10 years in robotics or automation applications, including at least 2 years leading engineers or projects.

• Hands-on robot/cobot or mobile robot commissioning, with PLC, servo and machine vision integration.

• Proven experience delivering demos, technical presentations and customer training.

• Strong customer-handling skills and willingness to travel to customer sites.

Good to Have

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus.

• AMR/AGV fleet deployment, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus.

• Robot cell layout, simulation or offline programming.

• Exposure to safety standards and risk assessment for robot cells and mobile robots.

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work directly with our design and manufacturing teams, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity.

• Real ownership: build your team, set the standards and make fast calls, with direct access to leadership.

• Grow as we grow: as the robotics vertical scales, your role grows into senior technical and business leadership.

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, manufacturer certifications, and new tech in mobile robotics, vision and motion control.

• High-impact projects: lead flagship deployments in factories, warehouses and new applications for key customers.

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance incentives and a supportive, growing team.

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners.

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna.co.in and recruitment1@luna.co.in with the subject "FAM – Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi).

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

* Drive proposal development, bid governance, commercial negotiations, risk management and deal closure.

* Respond to RFIs, RFPs and security questionnaires with accurate technical content and compliance matrices.
* Position and design Fortinet solutions for use cases such as:
* Mobile core and 4G/5G network security, subscriber and Gi/N6 LAN protection
* Carrier-grade NAT (CGNAT) and large-scale firewalling
* Threat mitigation and protection for AI factories and AI workloads.
* SD-WAN, SASE, ZTNA and managed security services for enterprise customers
* Secure data center, cloud and virtualized/containerized (NFV/CNF) environments
* Centralized management, logging, analytics and SOC/SIEM integration

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple opportunities at once.

* Industry certifications such as CCNP, JNCIP, CISSP, PCNSE or equivalent.

title: Domain Consultant 2
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
**Job Description**
**Your Career**
As a domain consultant for network security transformation, you provide technical expertise and guidance in customers'
**network security and zero trust journey**
. You will be key in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives. You evangelize our industry leadership in
**on-prem, cloud, and security services**
that establish Palo Alto Networks as a customer’s cybersecurity partner.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Collaborate with sales teams to recommend and develop customer solutions within your assigned specialization.
* Present to customers as our expert at all levels in the customer hierarchy, from practitioner to senior leadership.
* Lead and support customer demonstrations that showcase our unique value proposition.
* Responsible for prospective customers and partners' Technical Validation projects based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities.
* Architect solutions that will help our customers strengthen and simplify their security posture
* Document high-level design and key use cases to ensure proper implementation and value realization of Palo Alto Networks solutions
* Lead conversations about industry trends and emerging changes to the security landscape.
* Responsible for discussing and highlighting product alignment with customer requirements and differentiation
* As the main technical point of contact for Network Security, you will assist and collaborate to respond effectively to RFIs/RFPs.
* Position Palo Alto Networks or Partner delivered services as appropriate to ensure proper implementation and value realization of Palo Alto Networks solutions
* Discuss, with credibility, competitive offers in the marketplace and position ours as the best alternative

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**
Your Experience
  
  

* 3+ years experience in pre-sales/sales engineering within Zero Trust, Networking, Network Security, SaaS Security or SSE/SASE or graduate of Palo Alto Networks Academy Program
* Experience with L2-L4 Networking (L2 Switching architectures including Spanning Tree, VLANs/trunking, IP routing including static routes, OSPF and BGP, route re-distribution, L4 Load-balancing)
* Outstanding customer communication and problem-solving skills
* Experience in working with customers, demonstrating problem-solving skills and a can-do attitude
* Solid understanding of NGFW, Network Security, SASE, SD-WAN, CASB, Proxy, DLP and BYOD Solutions
* Knowledge of On-Premise and Cloud-Delivered Network Security Technologies
* This is a field sales position where travel requirements may be required to support in person customer meetings, please discuss with the recruiter on the specifics for this position.
* Proficient in English

**The Team**
Our Domain Consultant team members work hand-in-hand with organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire,and empower our potential clients in their journey to security.
  
  
You are empowered with unmatched systems and tools and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. Our Solutions Consulting community is driven by the mission to be our customers’ cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting their digital way of life.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Security Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on application security, secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices, and vulnerability management, particularly within cloud-native or hybrid environments.
* Experience with cloud and software development.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related technical field.
* Experience with AI-powered security tools for automated vulnerability detection, exploit generation, and code fix remediation.
* Experience in a customer-facing technical role, delivering product and solution briefings, partnering with security leaders and technical teams, and optimizing for production results.
* Understanding of the impact of AI on both offensive and defensive security strategies, including how AI can be leveraged to exploit binaries and firmware as source code.
* Familiarity with platforms for deploying and managing security agents or AI models for security applications, particularly in code analysis and remediation workflows.

**About The Job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
As a Customer Engineer, you will help grow our cyber security business by building and expanding relationships with new and existing customers. You will be a trusted advisor to customers and an advocate for our security solutions. You will provide support to C-level, security leaders, cloud security architects and security analysts, using both technical and business skill sets to lead projects forward. You will accompany customers in discovering the technology/solution and consult around the best way to secure and ensure compliance. You will optimize for results when in production, leading with empathy, while identifying innovative ways to multiply the impact of the team.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work with the team to identify and qualify business opportunities, understand customer technical objections, and develop the strategy to resolve technical blockers.
* Work directly with customers to demonstrate and prototype Google Cloud product integrations in customer/partner environments.
* Recommend integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure required to complete solutions using best practices on Google Cloud.
* Share security experience to support the technical relationship with customers, including product and solution briefings and proof-of-concept work, partnering with product management to prioritize solutions impacting customer engagement with Google Cloud.
* Support customer-facing presentations and conduct workshops to share the experience and be a subject matter expert on cyber security.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

The CPG industry relies on NielsenIQ for understanding emerging market trends for their growth strategy and NielsenIQ provides information services and products to our manufacturers, that helps them take strategic business decisions. Our data offers comprehensive and timely information on market shares and category performance, competitive sales volumes and insights into distribution, pricing, merchandising and promotion. This role is for Account Development Lead who will be responsible for generating revenue and managing relationship with Multinational CPG manufacturers based in India.

**Responsibilities**

At NielsenIQ we autonomously contribute to analysis that resolves specific Customer concerns.

This role serves as a bridge between the Commercial team, and various other teams like Quality Assurance, Operations, Engineering, & Data Science teams with regards to Customer requirements on business and insights. It also seeks to provide a strategic analysis that enables business decision making of our customers.

This role will enable customers to realize value potential of NIQ products and services. It will help our customers to get strategic insights and participate in customer business reviews with the aim to safequard and grow revenue.

Helps in setting priorities for NIQ to contribute to customer success function. This role entails planning along with the team for delivery of services to manufacturers & retailers using core NIQ products and services in retail measurement, E-commerce, and Analytics. * Responsible for the day-to-day management of the customer, building customer engagement, focused on value creation

**Opportunity & Pursuit Management**

* Plan a portfolio of work such as adoption of new NIQ products and services, support programs and projects, and value realization in alignment with customer business objectives

* Work closely with Sales Account managers to maintain a stronger pipeline of opportunities through a pre-qualified opportunity tracking: Sales Account Managers

**Consumption & Delivery Execution**

* Record and measure product adoption rate for a pre-assigned list of customers and strategize windows of opportunity with the Sales team

* Work with internal teams using functional knowledge to spot the right team members to support delivery to customers

**WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?**

Individuals with prior experience in solving retail (traditional/ modern trade and E-commerce) specific solutions around sales analytics, demand management, merchandizing, brand health, salesforce activation and retail measurement. Expertise in specific product category or distribution channel will be an added advantage. With acumen to work in a matrix organization that leverages leadership and influencing skills.

* MBA (desirable) with 5-8 years’ experience in FMCG / Service / Retail industry
* Strong Customer Focus and Proactiveness
* Very Good Influencing, Persuading and Project Management Skills
* Ability to connect and link insights to customers business

* Excellent oral and written communication

* Problem-solving approach and attitude

A proven commercial person, who can build and execute sales strategy plan, and be accountable for end-to-end sales operations process i.e. prospecting, developing, proposal building, negotiating and closing sales.
