title: Senior FP&A & Financial Modeling Consultant
description:
**Location:**
India — Remote
  
  
**Company:**
Limelight Software, Toronto, Canada
  
  
**About The Role**
You’ve built financial models for different businesses, worked directly with clients or portfolio companies, and learned how to turn complex financial questions into practical recommendations.
  
  
At Limelight, you’ll bring that experience to help finance teams improve how they budget, forecast, and report.
  
  
We’re looking for a
**Senior Consultant, Financial Modeling & FP&A**
with experience in financial advisory, transaction advisory, private equity, venture capital, or a similar environment. You should have built models for multiple clients or portfolio companies, with the ability to understand a new business, identify its financial drivers, and design a model around them.
  
  
Using Limelight’s FP&A platform, you’ll turn that knowledge into connected planning models, reports, and dashboards. You’ll work directly with CFOs, Controllers, and business leaders, taking ownership of both the financial solution and the client relationship.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Understand each client’s business. Lead discovery sessions to identify revenue drivers, cost structures, planning requirements, and reporting needs
* Build financial models from the ground up. Develop integrated models covering revenue, workforce, operating expenses, capital expenditure, balance sheets, and cash flow
* Turn analysis into working solutions. Translate spreadsheet models and business requirements into scalable planning models within Limelight
* Develop forecasts and scenarios. Help clients assess growth plans, hiring decisions, funding needs, and changes in business performance
* Advise finance leaders. Explain assumptions, challenge inconsistencies, and recommend approaches that improve planning and decision-making
* Manage client engagements. Own scope, timelines, deliverables, and communication across multiple projects
* Deliver reliable results. Validate calculations, reconcile source data, and ensure models and reports work together accurately
* Support client adoption. Train finance teams and help them confidently maintain and use the solutions you build

What You’ll Bring
  
  
**Experience Across Multiple Businesses**

* A track record of building financial models for several external clients or portfolio companies
* Experience in financial advisory, transaction advisory, valuation and modeling, outsourced CFO services, private equity, venture capital, or a comparable consulting environment
* The ability to get up to speed on different business models and industries quickly
* Ownership of substantial modeling work, including developing assumptions, structuring calculations, validating outputs, and presenting findings

**Strong Financial Modeling And FP&A Skills**

* Advanced Excel skills and experience building driver-based forecasts, integrated three-statement models, scenario analyses, and management reports
* A strong understanding of accounting, working capital, cash flow, and business performance
* The ability to build models that support ongoing budgeting and operating decisions, alongside any valuation or transaction experience
* Sound judgment about model structure, assumptions, accuracy, and usability

**Client and project management**

* Experience working directly with clients or portfolio company leadership to gather requirements and recommend solutions
* Confidence explaining financial concepts and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders
* The ability to manage several engagements, set clear expectations, and deliver work on time
* A practical, collaborative approach to solving problems and taking ownership

**Technology and industry exposure**

* An interest in applying financial expertise through modern FP&A technology
* Experience with FP&A platforms, ERP systems, or finance transformation projects is an asset. Training on Limelight will be provided
* Nonprofit finance experience, including grant or fund planning, is a welcome asset

Education and Experience
  
  

* 8+ years of relevant experience in financial modeling, FP&A, corporate finance, or advisory
* CA, CFA, CMA, MBA in Finance, or an equivalent finance qualification
* Relevant backgrounds may include modeling and advisory teams at BDO, PwC, EY, Deloitte, KPMG, boutique advisory firms, or private equity and venture capital firms

Why Join Limelight?
  
  
Limelight is a Toronto-based software company helping finance teams simplify budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
  
  
You’ll join a collaborative team of finance and technology professionals, work with businesses across North America, and see your financial expertise become part of how clients run their organizations.
  
  
We value clear communication, shared learning, and people who take ownership. This role offers the opportunity to build meaningful client relationships, solve varied financial challenges, and help shape better ways of working.

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About Anthropic**
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.
  
  
Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation
* Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success
* Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work
* Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives
* Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
* Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
* Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
* Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
* Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
* Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
* Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
**Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: DHS Technical Services Specialist
description:
**With a passion for life**
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

As a Digital Health Solutions (DHS) Technical Services Specialist for T-DOC and Tegris, your primary focus will be on managing project planning, installation, and aftersales services for hospital clients in Southeast Asia and India. You will deliver these activities directly or in collaboration with partners and distributors to ensure solutions are implemented in compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements, while achieving the highest level of customer satisfaction.

* Manage project implementations from planning through installation, testing and commissioning (T&C), and final handover.
* Conduct comprehensive user training sessions following successful installation to ensure effective and proficient system utilization.
* Maintain thorough documentation for all project phases, including customer milestone sign-offs and acceptance records.

* Perform system maintenance, software updates, and upgrades, either remotely or on-site as required.
* Provide timely and effective after sales support by identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving customer issues.
* Maintain detailed documentation of all ongoing service issues in the local system, including issue descriptions, resolutions, and follow-up actions.
* Carry out all activities in accordance with company protocols and regulatory requirements.

**Service Level Agreements (SLAs)**

* Prepare SLAs in line with company standards and customer requirements.
* Ensure customer requests are fulfilled within the agreed timelines and conditions defined in the SLAs.
* Support upselling opportunities with existing customers by identifying potential needs and providing consultative recommendations.

**Technical Support To Sales Team As And When Required**

* Provide technical support to the Sales team during quotation and tender phases by proposing cost-effective solutions that meet customer needs and requirements.
* Support the Sales team with technical presentations and product demonstrations, ensuring clear and effective communication of product and service features and benefits.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* At least 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in healthcare IT, network, or digital health solutions.
* Experience with healthcare integration projects and clinical workflows is highly desirable.
* Experience troubleshooting software, hardware, and network-connected systems.
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

**Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Healthcare IT systems, digital health solutions, and hospital workflows
* Hospital Information Systems (HIS), Electronic Medical Records (EMR/EHR), and systems integration.
* Hospital interoperability standards and protocols.
* Experience working within CSSD (Central Sterile Services Department) and Operating Room (OR) environments.
* Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VPN, LAN/WAN).
* Server administration and SQL.
* Windows operating systems, software deployment, and system integration.
* Service management, SLAs, and regulatory/compliance requirements.

**Skills**

* Technical troubleshooting and problem resolution.
* Project management and implementation coordination.
* Customer training and technical presentations.
* Documentation, reporting, and stakeholder management.
* Strong communication and customer-facing skills.

**Abilities**

* Manage projects independently from planning through customer acceptance.
* Work collaboratively with sales teams, customers, distributors, and partners.
* Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Prioritize multiple tasks while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
* Identify service improvement and upselling opportunities.
* Ability to forge and maintain relationships with customers.

**About Us**
With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

title: Technical Consultant
description:
**Technical Consultant – Fraud & Security Intelligence**
**About The Role**
Help leading financial institutions across Asia Pacific solve complex Fraud and Financial Crime challenges through innovative analytics, AI, and enterprise technology.
  
  
As a Technical Consultant within SAS's Fraud & Security Intelligence practice, you'll work directly with customers to understand their business challenges, lead discovery workshops, design enterprise solutions, and deliver successful transformation programmes across the region.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to combine technical expertise with business consulting while building trusted customer relationships and delivering measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead customer workshops to understand business, functional, and technical requirements.
* Design, implement, and optimize Fraud, Financial Crime, and Compliance solutions that address customer business and regulatory requirements.
* Translate business requirements into scalable solution designs and implementation approaches.
* Deliver end-to-end solution implementation, from requirements analysis and solution configuration through testing, deployment, and post-production support.
* Lead technical workstreams and collaborate with customer business and technology teams to solve complex implementation challenges.
* Build trusted customer relationships by providing technical leadership and consulting throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop reusable delivery assets, best practices, and innovative approaches that improve delivery quality and efficiency.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to the growth of the regional consulting practice.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 4–8 years of consulting, enterprise software implementation, or solution delivery experience. Strong candidates with slightly less experience may also be considered.
* Experience delivering enterprise Fraud, Financial Crime, or Compliance solutions within Banking, Financial Services, FinTech, or Payments organizations.
* Experience leading technical workstreams and working directly with customers, business stakeholders, and technology teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within regional and global delivery teams.
* Willingness to travel across Asia Pacific as required.

**Technical & Domain Expertise**

* Experience implementing enterprise Fraud, Financial Crime, or Compliance solutions.
* Experience with Financial Crime platforms such as SAS, NICE Actimize, Oracle FCCM, FICO, Quantexa, Symphony AI NetReveal, or equivalent enterprise solutions.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, Linux/Unix, ETL, APIs, cloud technologies (including Kubernetes), and enterprise application integration.
* Understanding of Fraud and Financial Crime domains including Payment Fraud, Card Fraud, Digital Banking Fraud, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions Screening, Customer Due Diligence (CDD/KYC), and Financial Crime Investigations.

**Who You Are**
**You are someone who:**

* Enjoys solving complex business and technology challenges.
* Takes ownership and consistently delivers high-quality outcomes.
* Builds trusted relationships through professionalism, credibility, and collaboration.
* Communicates confidently with customers, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
* Has a growth mindset with a passion for continuous learning and mastering new technologies.
* Thrives in collaborative, multicultural consulting environments.
* Is passionate about helping customers combat fraud and financial crime.
* Aspires to become a Solution Architect, Consulting Manager, or Practice Leader.

**Career Growth**
At SAS, you'll work on some of the largest Fraud and Financial Crime transformation programmes across Asia Pacific while collaborating with industry experts and leading financial institutions.
  
  
This role provides an excellent opportunity to build deep expertise across Fraud & Security Intelligence solutions while progressing towards Solution Architect, Project Lead, Consulting Manager, or Practice Leader roles within SAS Professional Services.
  
  
You'll be encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, continuously develop your expertise, and contribute to the growth of one of Asia Pacific's leading Fraud & Security Intelligence consulting practices.

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
**Company Description**
Aegion is an applied AI lab focused on engineering verifiable intelligence into the core operations of institutions in critical industries. The team brings experience from organizations such as Amazon, Uber, OpenAI, Hotstar, Accel, and BCG. Aegion partners with financial services, healthcare, and commerce institutions to build reliable AI systems where operational and regulatory stakes are high. Its engineers embed within critical functions, leverage the institution’s own data, and design systems so every action is logged, auditable, and explainable. Aegion offers a mission-driven environment for professionals who want to shape how AI is safely deployed in real-world operations.

**Role Description**
The Deployment Strategist is a full-time role based in India (Mumbai/ Bangalore) or UAE (Dubai). Deployment strategists own the problem inside each institution we work with. You sit with executives, find the critical function where AI can change the economics, and design the engagement that proves it. Then you stay with it, alongside our embedded engineers, from first design to full operation, until the result shows in the numbers.

This is not a sales role, and it is not a consulting role. You are accountable for a working system and the result it produces.

**What you will do**

* Meet executives in financial services, healthcare and commerce, and get to the operation behind their question: how work moves, what it costs, where it breaks.
* Size the value in a function in plain numbers, and agree the baseline we will be measured against.
* Scope the first engagement: one critical function, proved in production.
* Work with our engineers on the data, architecture and methods, and translate between the institution’s teams and ours.
* Run the engagement week to week: decisions, risks, stakeholders and results.
* Find the next function and build the case to extend.
* Bring what you learn back into how we build.

**What we are looking for**

* 3–8 years in strategy or operations consulting, private-equity value creation, or an operating role where you owned a process or P&L line at scale.
* You can model the economics of a workflow from scratch and defend it in front of a CFO.
* You are comfortable with data. You can work in SQL or a notebook, and you understand how machine-learning and language models behave well enough to scope them honestly.
* Clear, short writing. Composure with senior people. A habit of doing the work yourself.
* Experience in financial services or healthcare operations is a plus.
* You are willing to spend much of your week with the institutions we serve.

**What you can expect**

* Work on systems in production. Delivering real business value on the P&L.
* A small team with a high bar, working directly with the founders.
* Ownership of results, not hours.
* Competitive salary and equity.

You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend business expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots and workshops.

title: Sr. Specialist, Advisory Services
description:
**Position Summary**

Women’s World Banking is looking for a team member to join a forward thinking, cross-functional, high-performing, collaborative team focused on delivering innovative customer experiences, banking services and products, that create business and customer value to serve low-income women.

The Sr. Specialist will lead the design & implementation of advisory solutions in the field in collaboration with our Financial Service Partners. The candidate will be expected to understand business and customer needs, design solutions across functional teams, coordinate and lead sales/ channel teams, last mile marketing & sales agencies and bank stakeholders to ensure smooth implementation and drive project results. This role is responsible for managing project and providing excellent service delivery for our clients and stakeholders.

The ideal candidate will have either a background in banking / insurance / financial services or in management consulting. You must be a strategic thinker with the ability to see the big picture and propose new ideas for ways of engaging Women’s World Banking’s target audience.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Design of Financial Solutions**
in the space of savings, micro-credit, micro-insurance, digital financial services, or last mile solutions for low income women that are viable and scalable for Financial Service Providers:

* Develop research based perspective on financial products for low income women - the current context, challenges for women, trends and solutions for increasing financial inclusion of women in this sector.
* Conduct industry assessments that provide detailed insights into the competitive landscape and best practices; Collect and analyze complex data in the sector that can help define solutions.
* Establish relationships and collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business and customer needs, continually enhance project processes, service offering and delivery for partners.
* Identify, scope and find implementation paths for needed product and/or customer experience enhancements;
* Develop business cases for new product and product enhancements to enable prioritization and justify investments into new and existing products.

**Delivery of Solutions in Field**
across various initiatives, locations and stakeholders to ensure project milestones and metrics are met. Drive execution of solutions for low income women with institution partners.

* Able to implement project in field across multiple geographies and last mile channels.
* Establish relationships and work with a cross-functional teams (internal and partner bank's) to ensure timely delivery of milestones.
* Coordinate among various external support organisations such as last mile agencies (training, sales promotions etc.) and local government bodies (state / region level) to drive project success.
* Lead project management including the development, delivery and monitoring of work plans, milestones, targets, budgets, and both internal and external reporting. Projects may vary in number, size and complexity.

**Mange & Deepen Relationships with Institutional Partners:**

* Develop, and drive execution of high priority business initiatives, financial products and services for the partner FSPs
* Establish and maintain positive and constructive relationships with key client contacts
* Initiate and hand hold the project through all stages of the project
* Ensure positive client satisfaction results.
* Be the “voice of the clients” by interpreting the clients’ business plans and strategic intent into the Women’s World banking organization.

**Required Qualifications**

* MBA or Master’s degree in related field
* 8+ years or more experience in banking, financial services, consulting or other relevant role.
* Demonstrated ability to execute and successfully manage multiple projects in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Proven collaborative, negotiation, and persuasion skills to influence field teams and senior management at partner institutions.
* Must be willing to travel extensively within India, and be on-site for 6-8 days a month.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Interest in the field of women’s financial inclusion and economic empowerment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to present fact-based recommendations in a clear, logical and concise way to tell a story with the data.
* Track record of superior creativity and problem solving abilities.

**Measure of Success**

**Success within the first 75 days:**

* Embrace Women’s World Banking’s values – Think Big, Own and commit to it, Smarter together
* Assume full responsibility of the position;
* Forge positive working relationships with cross-functional staff and fully integrate in the India team
* Become trained in and fully integrate the use of Women’s World Banking systems and policies into your day-to-day activities;
* Learn and comprehend the Women’s World Banking business model and work closely with the team to understand and build upon existing plans.

title: SOLUTION MANAGER - PRESALES L4
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of this role is to help build pipeline by effectively understanding client requirements and liaising with internal functions/stakeholders to prepare a winning solution by leveraging the capabilities within D&OP for the client. 

͏

**Do**

* **Prepare a winning solution for the fulfill the requirements of the client**
  + Requirement Understanding, Data Gathering & Solution Design
    - Engage with the customers, understand and interpret their needs correctly, and churn out a proposal with a solution that is aligned with the customers' demands/requirements
    - Engage with clients or sales team to understand the purpose of the proposal, the requirements and expectations of the client
    - Lead and prepare the RFP/RFI/RFQ responses and presentations. Write, edit and finalize each section of a proposal, ensuring the content matches the RFP
    - Ensure RFP instructions pertaining to format, fonts, page limits, etc. are being followed along with internal branding guidelines
    - Performs final electronic layout and formatting as well as production of hard copies as required
    - Follow up with sales team post submission of RFP response
  + Co-ordination and Support to Internal Teams
    - Coordinates with partners to request and collect relevant data and inputs or other narratives to respond to proposal requirements
    - Work with sales team proactively and provide support for 2nd and 3rd level customer meetings.
    - Prepare a list of questions and of information/material needed to create the proposal
    - Include standard or approved proposal language for legal sections according to company policy
    - Write the proposal and/or coordinate with team members to ensure each section is written in a consistent format and completed according to the RFP instructions
    - Work with internal marketing team and external vendors for the purpose of proposal creation
    - Support the marketing team and create specific client dockets, collaterals, mailers etc.
    - Support the demand generating team of the marketing department by providing them lists of the accounts, stakeholders etc. that can be targeted

͏

* **Effective Project Management**
  + Effectively and efficiently plan, organize, lead and control the delivery of the final solution/proposal/document
  + Prepare a work plan that lists the tasks required to create the proposal, such as design, writing, editing, review and production
  + Uses strong interpersonal, organizational, and time management skills to juggle multiple tasks with differing deadlines to consistently produce the document
  + Collaborate and influence internal key stakeholders to get relevant data within the specified timeline to ensure relevant data in plugged into the solution
  + Ensure promptness and compliance of proposals by creating and managing proposal calendars, compliance checklists, compliance matrices, trackers, etc.
  + Oversees collection and completion of all proposal components (technical, cost, management, annexes) working in collaboration with internal teams, as well as partners.
  + Follow up with relevant stakeholders/teams to get feedback and revisions and ensure that the proposal development stays on schedule.
  + Update the sales team and other stakeholders on a regular basis on the progress of the proposal
* **Stakeholder Interaction & Management**
  + Work with internal teams and get relevant data/inputs for preparing documents such as RFP responses, capability demonstrations, client presentations and collaterals, participating in the customer calls to sell solutions etc.
  + Collaborate with relevant stakeholders/teams to get feedback and make revisions to ensure that the proposal stays relevant to the needs throughout various proposal stages
  + Ensures communication among all parties throughout the proposal process
  + Identifies bottlenecks in the process escalating accordingly to higher level, as necessary, to ensure timetable and deliverables remain on track
  + Reach out to the below mentioned internal teams during proposal creation:

͏

**Deliver**

No.Performance ParameterMeasure1.Process & Performance Zero non-conformance on timelines with respect to the client/ stakeholder requirements
  
%Winning solutions created
  
Support on pipeline generation
  
 2.Client No. of RFP/Proposals/Solutions submitted

title: Principal Solutions Consultant
description:
**Job Description**

**Role Overview**

Guidewire’s Go to Market organization is focused on scaling AI‑powered innovation, expanding into new markets and product categories, and ensuring every customer is successful and referenceable through structured, data‑driven execution and tight cross‑functional alignment.

As a Principal Solution Consultant, you sit at the intersection of this vision and our India growth strategy, serving as the senior field‑facing authority on how Guidewire’s platform, cloud services, and ecosystem can unlock value for Indian insurers.

Operating as a key member of the regional GTM leadership team, you will design and execute market‑entry and expansion plays for India, partnering closely with Sales, Professional Services, Product, and our partner ecosystem. You will champion local market needs back into our global roadmap while coaching and scaling an India‑based Solution Consulting team. This is a high‑impact, highly visible role for someone who is equally comfortable in the boardroom, on customer sites, and in the details of complex insurance workflows.

**Core Objectives:**

* Go-to-Market Strategy: Co-own and execution of the Indian GTM strategy.
* Strategic Deal Lead: Own the functional "Win Theme" for major prospects, moving beyond feature lists to business outcomes.
* Market Challenger: Effectively position Guidewire as the modern SaaS alternative to legacy incumbents.
* Executive Advisor: Have the gravitas to engage with C-suite stakeholders (CEO, CTO, Business Unit Leaders).
* Thought Leadership: Act as the voice of the Indian market, specifically regarding industry trends, to influence global product roadmaps.
* You’ll work closely with Indian customers, SI Partners, internal product and field teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve the above objectives. You’ll also support the development of our local team and help scale our operation across the market.

**Key Responsibilities**

* GTM Strategy & Execution: Partner with Field Leadership to refine the India penetration plan. Identify high-propensity targets, define regional "Win Themes," and tailor the global sales playbook for the Indian context.
* Strategic Market Research: Conduct "boots-on-the-ground" discovery to identify unique Indian functional gaps (e.g., specific IRDAI compliance workflows, UPI-based real-time claims, or localized Health TPA models) vs Guidewire’s "Out-of-the-Box" (OOTB) features.
* Competitive Intelligence: Build a detailed "Battlecard" against local incumbents. Identify their architectural weaknesses in the Indian market and train the wider field team on how to exploit them.
* End-to-End Deal Ownership: Lead the functional sales cycle, from initial discovery and RFI/RFP management to final selection and contract alignment.
* Field Leadership Collaboration: Act as the primary technical/functional advisor to the Regional Sales Director and Managing Director. Provide the "solution air cover" needed to close the first wave of lighthouse customers.
* Consultative Discovery: Uncover the "pain behind the pain" in a prospect’s current operations (e.g., rigid legacy codebases, slow speed-to-market for new products).
* Solution Design: Partner with Account Executives to build a cohesive business case, ensuring all functional risks are mitigated.
* Product Localization Advocacy: Collate recurring requirements from Indian prospects and present a prioritized "India Roadmap" to Global Product Management.
* Team Leadership: Develop the India-based Solution Consulting team by coaching them on advanced storytelling, competitive positioning, and executive presence.
* Ecosystem Integration: Work with the Guidewire Marketplace and local partners to demonstrate a "frictionless" insurance experience (e.g., integrating with the India Stack, UPI, and AI-driven fraud detection).

**Product & Domain Expertise**

* India P&C Mastery: Deep expertise in the Indian General Insurance market.
* Competitive Displacement: Proven ability to position modern SaaS against legacy core insurance solutions. You must be able to articulate why a modern cloud platform beats a "One-Size-Fits-All" legacy suite.
* Digital Ecosystem (India Stack): Knowledge of how to leverage Aadhaar, UPI, and DigiLocker within the insurance lifecycle to create a frictionless, paperless customer journey.
* Guidewire Cloud Value: Ability to sell the "Evergreen" nature of SaaS—proving to Indian CIOs that they will never have to perform a painful 2-year legacy upgrade again.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

**Professional Experience**

* 12+ Years in Enterprise Pre-Sales/Solution Consulting: A proven track record of leading functional sales cycles for complex, high-value SaaS or Core Systems (Policy, Billing, Claims).
* Market Entry Expertise: Experience working in a "pioneer" or "early-hire" capacity for a global technology firm entering the Indian market is highly desirable.
* Competitive Displacement: Demonstrated success in unseating legacy or entrenched incumbents (specifically TCS BaNCS, SAP, or Oracle) within the Indian Financial Services sector.

**Domain & Technical Mastery**

* Indian P&C Specialist: Deep functional expertise in general insurance. You should understand the nuances of the Indian "Grid" system, TPA integrations, and IRDAI product filing requirements.
* Cloud/SaaS Evangelist: While Guidewire experience is a plus, you must have a strong grasp of Cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure) and the ability to sell the business value of "Evergreen" software over traditional on-premise and custom build models.
* Digital Ecosystem Knowledge: Familiarity with the India Stack (Aadhaar, UPI, eSign) and how these technologies are being leveraged to digitize the insurance value chain.

**Leadership & Strategic Skills**

* Field Partnership: Experience working as a "Strategic Right Hand" to Sales VPs or Managing Directors to build and execute a Go-to-Market (GTM) plan.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional "C-Suite" communication skills; the ability to challenge the thinking of a CEO/CIO and move them from a "safe" legacy choice to a transformative platform.
* Consultative Storytelling: Mastery of "The Challenger Sale" or similar methodologies—turning dry product features into a compelling business narrative that addresses specific Indian market pain points.

title: Senior System Engineer
description:
**Senior System Engineer -SASE**

**Location: Mumbai**

**Description**

**About Us**

Versa Networks, Inc. is a leading vendor of next-generation Software Defined solutions and architectures, called Unified-SASE (Secure Access Service Edge). Versa is providing an end-to-end solution that both simplifies and secures the WAN/branch office network as well as securing connectivity for remote users.

The Goal Of Versa Networks Is To Provide Unprecedented Business Advantages Through a Software-based Approach That Allows For Unmatched Agility, Cost Savings And Flexibility. We Have Created a Feature-rich, Scalable Yet Simple To Use Software Platform To Implement Many Different Enterprise And Service Provider Use Cases, Including

* Full software-defined and Unified SASE for enterprise customers or MSP’s.
* Secure SD-WAN for enterprises with layered security.
* Leading and award winning Cloud Security through the Versa SASE Fabric.

We are looking for passionate, entrepreneurial, and tech-savvy Sr. Systems Engineers to help our customers and partners evaluate, adopt and expand the use of our technology.

**Job responsibilities**

* Provide pre-sales technical support and technical expertise to our customers and partners with objective to achieve sales targets.
* Establish trusted advisory role with strategic customers and partners (CIO, CISO).
* Enable and/or update partner network on product evolution.
* Perform workshops with prospects or customers on product evaluations and do demonstrations.
* Perform hands-on tests to validate customer proof-of-concept setups, network designs, and network deployments using new products and feature.
* Respond to RFI’s/RFP’s.
* Provide market and product feedback to product management and back-office.
* Keep up-to-date on competitive solutions, products, and services.
* Author whitepapers, knowledge base articles, and other customer/partner facing content.

**Essential Skills**

* Experience in planning and designing or operating service provider or large enterprise WAN/LAN networks
* Knowledge on solutions on Cloud security with FWaaS, DLP, CASB, RBI and Malware prevention solutions.
* Knowledge on technologies used in the security scene, such as proxies, SSL/TLS, VPN’s, Active Director/SAML/LDAP, threat prevention and mitigation
* Understanding networking and security architectures on the SASE framework.
* In depth understanding of TCP/IP protocol stack and operation.
* Knowledge on WAN technologies and protocols like MPLS, MPLS based VPNs, BGP, OSPF, QoS, NAT, Multicast.
* Knowledge in architecting and/or managing large-scale, high performing and resilient Enterprise networking and security solutions.
* Knowledge on Linux administration.

**Desired Skills**

* Knowledge on best practices architectures for SaaS applications.
* Hands-on experience in public and private cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, Openstack, VMware.
* Shell scripting, python scripting knowledge.

**Competency**

* Great analytical thinking.
* Ability to think full stack when it comes to problem solving.
* Ability to learn new technology quickly.
* Excellent hands-on skills in deploying and troubleshooting complex networks.
* Willingness to help customers, peers and other team members at any time.

**Our Benefits**

Versa Networks is a small but rapidly growing organization. It is built by people with vast experience in the networking industry. We are a pragmatic team with a healthy work-life balance. We offer competitive compensation packages with pre-IPO equity. Additionally, we offer a quality of life benefit to everyone in an inspiring environment with skilled and passionate co-workers. Our exciting company culture offers a great place to work and most important, to have fun.

title: Strategic Builder
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Sales
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.
  
  
Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value.
  
  
Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure
* AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.
* Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
* Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization
* Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.
* AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including
* Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development.
* Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.
* AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents
* Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 4+ years experience in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or programme management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have
* Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
* Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex

* Ensure proper scope mapping between supply items, exclusions, and client expectations.

* Identify opportunities for standardization and manufacturing optimization.
* Support management in improving pricing strategy, raw material and resources optimization and estimation accuracy.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

* Work closely with Sales, Design, R&D, Production, Planning, Purchase, and Accounts teams.
* Coordinate with factory teams for production lead times and feasibility.
* Support Management with budgeting and forecasting for upcoming projects.

* Maintain estimation databases and standard costing templates for future projects.

description:

Welcome to FinBox, the buzzing hive of tech innovation and creativity!
  
  
Since our inception in 2017, FinBox has built some of the most advanced technologies in the financial services space that help lenders like Banks, NBFCs and large enterprises build and launch credit products within a matter of days, not months or years. FinBox is a Series B funded company which is expanding globally with offices in India, Vietnam, Indonesia and Philippines.
  
  
Our vision is to build the best-in-class infrastructure for lending products and help Banks & Financial Services companies across the world scale and launch credit programs that set a new standard in the era of digital finance. So far, we’ve helped our customers disburse Billions of Dollars in credit across unsecured and secured credit including personal loans, working capital loans, business loans, mortgage and education loans. FinBox solutions are already being used by over 100+ companies to deliver credit to over 5 million customers every month.
  
  
**Why Should You Be a FinBoxer**

* Innovative Environment: At FinBox, we foster a culture of creativity and experimentation, encouraging our team to push the boundaries of what's possible in fintech.
* Impactful Work: Your contributions will directly impact the lives of millions, helping to provide fair and accessible credit to individuals and businesses alike.
* Growth Opportunities: We are a Series B funded startup and have ample opportunities for growth, professional development and career advancement.
* Collaborative Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive team of experts who are passionate about making a difference and supporting one another.

**Who’s a Great FinBoxer:**
At FinBox, we’re on the lookout for exceptional folks who are all about innovation and impact. If you’re excited to shake things up in the banking & financial services world, keep reading!
  
  
**Creative Thinkers:**
If your brain is always bubbling with out-of-the-box ideas and wild solutions, you’re our kind of person. We love disruptors who challenge the norm and bring fresh perspectives to the table.
  
  
**Customer Heroes:**
Our customers are our champions, and we need heroes who can understand their needs, deliver magical experiences, and go above and beyond to keep them happy.
  
  
**Team Players:**
We believe in the power of “we.” If you thrive in a collaborative environment, value different viewpoints, and enjoy being part of a spirited, supportive team, you’ll fit right in.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own end-to-end implementation of credit and lending products for new FinBox clients
* Collaborate with client credit/risk teams to define underwriting criteria, rule sets, and approval logic
* Translate credit policies into technical configurations within FinBox’s decisioning tools and APIs
* Coordinate cross-functionally with internal product, engineering, and customer success teams
* Act as the subject matter expert for credit risk workflows—pre, during, and post go-live
* Monitor early performance of launched credit products and recommend improvements
* Continuously refine implementation playbooks, templates, and best practices

****What We’re Looking For:****

* 3-5 years of experience in credit underwriting, credit operations, or credit product management
* Strong exposure to retail and/or SME lending processes in banks, NBFCs, or Fintechs
* 2+ years of hands-on experience in project management or credit tech implementation roles
* Familiarity with decisioning systems, rule engines, and credit scoring models
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills - internal and external
* A problem-solving mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in ambiguity
* Bonus: Experience working with BRE, policy frameworks, and low-code/no-code platforms

title: Controls panel estimation
description:
# JOB DESCRIPTION – INSIDE SALES ENGINEER

\*\*Company:\*\* Synergie Controls & Systems Pvt. Ltd.

\*\*Location:\*\* Taloja, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

\*\*Department:\*\* Sales & Business Development

\*\*Position:\*\* Inside Sales Engineer

\*\*Employment Type:\*\* Full-Time

\*\*Work Mode:\*\* Hybrid – Taloja Office + Work from Home as per company policy

\*\*Reporting To:\*\* Sales Manager / Head – Business Development

## 1. Job Purpose

The Inside Sales Engineer will be responsible for \*\*generating and qualifying sales enquiries, customer follow-up, preparing and coordinating quotations, maintaining the sales pipeline, and converting enquiries into orders\*\*.

The candidate will work closely with the \*\*Sales, Estimation, Engineering, Purchase, Stores and Project teams\*\* to ensure timely response to customers and effective closure of business opportunities.

The role is particularly focused on Synergie's \*\*Industrial Automation, Siemens products, PLC/HMI/SCADA, Drives, Control Panels, MCC/PCC Panels, automation projects and services\*\*.

## 2. Key Responsibilities

### A. Lead Generation & Customer Development

\* Generate new leads through:

\* Cold calling

\* Email campaigns

\* LinkedIn

\* Existing customer references

\* Online enquiries

\* Industrial databases

\* Customer mapping

\* Identify potential customers in:

\* Steel and metals

\* Manufacturing industries

\* OEMs

\* EPC contractors

\* System integrators

\* Panel builders

\* Pharma

\* Food & Beverage

\* Packaging

\* Water treatment

\* Cement, glass, rubber, sugar and other industries

\* Develop and maintain a database of prospective customers.

\* Identify decision-makers such as Purchase, Electrical, Automation, Maintenance, Projects and Plant Heads.

### B. Enquiry Management

\* Receive and understand customer enquiries.

\* Review technical requirements, BOQ, BOM, specifications and drawings.

\* Clarify missing information with customers.

\* Register every enquiry in the CRM/system.

\* Categorize enquiries based on product, project value, customer and probability.

\* Ensure no enquiry or customer follow-up is missed.

### C. Quotation & Pre-Sales Support

Coordinate with the estimation and engineering teams for preparation of:

\* Siemens PLC quotations

\* HMI and SCADA solutions

\* VFD / AC & DC Drive quotations

\* PLC/Automation Panels

\* MCC/PCC/LT Panels

\* Control Desks

\* DCS / PCS7 solutions

\* Retrofit and migration projects

\* Automation modification and upgradation

\* AMC and service requirements

Support preparation of \*\*BOQ/BOM, technical offers and techno-commercial quotations\*\*.

### D. Customer Follow-Up

\* Follow up systematically on all submitted quotations.

\* Understand the customer's feedback, competition and expected order date.

\* Record quotation status in CRM.

\* Follow up for:

\* Technical approval

\* Commercial negotiation

\* Purchase order

\* Payment

\* Dispatch

\* Maintain a daily follow-up schedule.

\* Escalate high-value or critical opportunities to the Sales Manager.

### E. Sales Conversion

\* Work towards converting enquiries into orders.

\* Understand why an enquiry is lost and record the reason.

\* Track:

\* Enquiry value

\* Quotation value

\* Expected order value

\* Probability

\* Expected order date

\* Competitor

\* Gross margin

\* Support negotiation with customers within approved company limits.

\* Identify opportunities for repeat business and additional products.

### F. CRM & Sales Reporting

Maintain accurate and updated information in \*\*Zoho CRM / company sales systems\*\*.

Daily update should include:

\* New enquiries

\* Calls made

\* Customer discussions

\* Quotations submitted

\* Follow-ups completed

\* Orders received

\* Lost enquiries

\* Next action and follow-up date

Prepare regular:

\* Daily sales activity report

\* Weekly enquiry report

\* Sales pipeline report

\* Quotation follow-up report

\* Order conversion report

\* Lost enquiry analysis

### G. Customer Relationship Management

\* Maintain professional communication with customers.

\* Develop long-term relationships with existing customers.

\* Regularly contact inactive/old customers.

\* Identify new requirements from existing customers.

\* Generate opportunities for:

\* Retrofit

\* PLC migration

\* Drive replacement

\* Panel modification

\* Automation upgradation

\* Service

\* AMC

\* Spares

\* New projects

### H. Coordination with Internal Teams

Coordinate closely with:

\*\*Sales → Estimation → Engineering → Purchase → Production → Testing → Projects → Accounts\*\*

Ensure proper communication of customer requirements and commercial commitments.

## 3. Technical Knowledge Required

Candidate should have basic understanding of:

\* Siemens PLC – S7-1200 / S7-1500

\* HMI

\* SCADA / WinCC

\* AC Drives / VFD

\* DC Drives

\* MCC / PCC / LT Panels

\* PLC Automation Panels

\* Control Panels

\* Electrical components

\* Motors and basic electrical systems

\* Industrial automation

\* Basic electrical drawings and BOQ/BOM

Knowledge of \*\*Siemens automation products\*\* will be strongly preferred.

## 4. Qualification

\*\*Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech\*\* in:

\* Electrical Engineering

\* Electronics Engineering

\* Electronics & Telecommunication

\* Instrumentation Engineering

\* Automation Engineering

MBA/PG Diploma in Sales & Marketing will be an advantage.

## 5. Experience

\*\*Experience:\*\* 1–5 years preferred.

Candidates with experience in:

\* Industrial Automation

\* Electrical products

\* Control Panels

\* Siemens products

\* Industrial B2B sales

\* Technical sales

\* Inside sales

\* Electrical/automation distribution

will be preferred.

Freshers with strong communication skills and technical knowledge may also be considered for a trainee/entry-level position.

## 6. Required Skills

### Technical Skills

\* Basic knowledge of PLC, HMI, SCADA and Drives

\* Understanding of electrical panels and automation products

\* Ability to understand BOQ/BOM

\* Basic technical proposal understanding

### Sales Skills

\* Lead generation

\* Cold calling

\* Customer follow-up

\* Enquiry handling

\* Quotation follow-up

\* Negotiation

\* Order conversion

\* Customer relationship management

### Software Skills

\* MS Excel

\* MS Word

\* PowerPoint

\* CRM software – preferably Zoho CRM

\* Email communication

\* Basic knowledge of ERP systems will be an advantage

### Behavioural Skills

\* Good spoken and written English

\* Good communication skills

\* Positive attitude

\* Strong follow-up discipline

\* Target-oriented approach

\* Ability to work independently

\* Good coordination skills

\* Professional customer handling

\* Willingness to learn

## 7. Hybrid Work Model

This position will follow a \*\*hybrid working model\*\*.

The employee may work from home for defined inside-sales activities such as:

\* Customer calling

\* Email follow-up

\* CRM updating

\* Lead generation

\* Quotation follow-up

\* Sales reporting

However, the employee must attend the \*\*Taloja office whenever required\*\* for:

\* Sales meetings

\* Internal coordination

\* Product/technical training

\* Quotation discussions

\* Customer meetings

\* Sales reviews

\* Team meetings

\* Important project discussions

\*\*Work-from-home is subject to performance, discipline, availability and management approval.\*\*

## 8. Key Performance Indicators – KPIs

The employee will be evaluated on:

| KPI | Measurement |

| ------------------ | ----------------------------------- |

| New Leads | Number of qualified leads generated |

| Customer Calls | Daily/weekly activity |

| Enquiries | Qualified enquiries generated |

| Quotations | Number and value of quotations |

| Follow-Up | % of quotations followed on time |

| Conversion | Enquiry-to-order conversion % |

| Sales | Monthly / annual order value |

| New Customers | Number of new active customers |

| CRM Discipline | 100% enquiry and follow-up updating |

| Lost Enquiries | Proper reason and analysis |

| Collection Support | Coordination for payment follow-up |

## 9. Sales Target Responsibility

The Inside Sales Engineer will be given \*\*monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets\*\*.

The employee is expected to build a healthy sales pipeline rather than only depend on enquiries received from existing customers.

Performance will be evaluated based on:

\*\*Lead Generation → Qualified Enquiry → Quotation → Follow-Up → Conversion → Order Value → Gross Margin\*\*

## 10. Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a candidate who is:

\* Technically inclined

\* Comfortable speaking with customers

\* Strong in follow-up

\* Target-oriented

\* Comfortable with telephone-based sales

\* Good in Excel and CRM

\* Interested in industrial automation

\* Willing to learn Siemens products

\* Capable of working independently in a hybrid environment

\* Focused on converting enquiries into business

## 11. Compensation & Incentives

Salary will be based on \*\*experience, technical knowledge and sales capability\*\*.

Performance-based incentives may be provided based on company sales and incentive policy.

## 12. Career Growth

A successful candidate can grow into:

\*\*Inside Sales Engineer → Senior Inside Sales Engineer → Technical Sales Engineer → Sales Manager → Business Development Manager\*\*

## 13. Important Requirement

\*\*This is not a simple telecalling position.\*\*

The candidate must be capable of understanding the customer's \*\*technical requirement, coordinating with the engineering/estimation team, following up commercially and contributing to actual order conversion.\*\*

India (Remote / Hybrid – Major Hubs: Mumbai\Noida)

**Presales / Solutions Consultant / Technical Advisor**

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Sales, Product Management, Professional Services, and Support teams to understand customer security challenges, design tailored solutions, deliver compelling product demonstrations, and lead proof-of-concept (PoC) engagements. You will also advise customers on integrating application security testing into DevSecOps pipelines and the Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SSDLC).

The ideal candidate combines strong application security expertise with excellent communication, presentation, and consultative selling skills to translate complex technical capabilities into measurable business value.

As a
**Presales/Solutions Consultant/Technical Advisor for AppScan,**
you will serve as the pre-sales technical expert supporting HCLSoftware’s application security portfolio in India, with a primary base in Mumbai. You’ll work closely with the Sales team to design customer-centric solutions, deliver impactful demos and PoCs, and guide organizations on best practices in application security. This role is pivotal in driving customer success, enabling product adoption, and contributing to overall revenue growth through technical excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical Presales and Solution Consulting**

* Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer environments, application security requirements, business objectives, and compliance needs.
* Design and present tailored AppScan solutions aligned with customer use cases, security maturity, and technology landscapes.
* Deliver engaging product demonstrations, technical workshops, and proof-of-concept engagements for HCL AppScan on-premises and cloud offerings.
* Translate technical capabilities into clear business outcomes, highlighting risk reduction, operational efficiency, and improved security coverage.
* Support the Sales team throughout the customer engagement lifecycle, from opportunity qualification to technical validation and deal closure.

**2. Application Security and DevSecOps Advisory**

* Advise customers on application security testing methodologies, including Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and related security practices.
* Guide customers in embedding application security testing into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps workflows.
* Recommend best practices for vulnerability identification, prioritization, remediation, and risk management.
* Help customers align application security programs with relevant industry standards, regulatory requirements, and secure coding practices.
* Support the adoption of risk-based application security testing strategies across the software development lifecycle.

**3. Customer Engagement and Technical Leadership**

* Act as a trusted technical advisor to security leaders, application development teams, DevSecOps engineers, and enterprise architects.
* Address technical objections, product-related queries, integration challenges, and competitive positioning requirements.
* Work with Professional Services, Product Management, Engineering, and Support teams to resolve technical challenges and deliver effective customer outcomes.
* Build strong customer relationships through technical credibility, responsiveness, and a consultative approach.
* Capture customer feedback, emerging requirements, and market insights to support continuous product and solution improvement.

**4. RFI/RFP and Competitive Enablement**

* Develop and contribute to technical responses for Requests for Information (RFIs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), security questionnaires, and solution assessments.
* Prepare solution architectures, technical presentations, implementation recommendations, and supporting documentation.
* Conduct competitive positioning against application security solutions such as OpenText Fortify, Checkmarx, Snyk, Veracode, and Burp Suite, based on relevant customer requirements and product capabilities.
* Clearly articulate solution differentiators, deployment options, integration capabilities, and business value.

You will own IVF equipment sales for a Mumbai-based territory, working directly with the embryologists and clinicians who run IVF labs. It is a hands-on, field-first role: you demo the equipment, win the order, and stay on to support the customer after the sale.

Assistant Sales Manager – IVF Equipment

DSS Imagetech Pvt. Ltd.

Mumbai

3 to 7 years

  ,

  ,

You will join DSS Imagetech Pvt. Ltd., part of the DSS Group of Companies, a healthcare conglomerate, and sell technology that sits at the heart of fertility care. title: Opportunity Manager
description:
Role Purpose
  
  
The Opportunity Manager is responsible for managing and driving multi product sales opportunities through the entire opportunity lifecycle, ensuring effective coordination between customers, sales teams, product specialists, operations, and other stakeholders.
  
  
The role focuses on maximizing win rates, ensuring high-quality opportunity management, maintaining CRM accuracy, and accelerating revenue growth through disciplined sales processes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Opportunity Management
  
  

* Own and manage qualified sales opportunities from identification through closure.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to develop customer-centric solutions and proposals.
* Drive opportunity planning, qualification, stakeholder mapping, and win strategies.
* Monitor opportunity progress and proactively address risks, blockers, and dependencies.

Sales Support & Commercial Excellence
  
  

* Support account teams in solution design, pricing, and proposal development.
* Ensure all opportunities are accurately maintained in CRM systems.
* Conduct regular pipeline reviews and opportunity health assessments.
* Maintain forecast accuracy and provide visibility of key deals and revenue potential.

Customer Engagement
  
  

* Act as a key point of coordination during the sales cycle.
* Understand customer requirements and translate them into actionable internal plans.
* Facilitate customer presentations, workshops, and solution discussions.
* Support contract negotiations and commercial discussions where required.

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Collaborate with Sales, Product, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Procurement teams, as and when needed
* Ensure timely engagement of subject matter experts and decision-makers.
* Drive alignment across teams to meet customer commitments and deadlines.

Performance & Reporting
  
  

* Track key opportunity metrics including pipeline value, conversion rates, win/loss ratios, and sales cycle duration.
* Prepare opportunity status reports for leadership reviews.
* Conduct win/loss analyses and identify improvement opportunities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, Sales, Marketing, or related field.
* 4-8 years of experience in sales operations, customer success, bid management, opportunity management, or commercial roles.
* Strong understanding of sales methodologies and opportunity management processes.
* Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Dynamics 365, or similar.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.
