title: TC-CS-AEET-Senior-ZT
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Cyber Security – Technology Consulting – Infrastructure Security – Zero Trust Security - Senior**
As part of our EY Cyber Security team, you shall be responsible for defining, solutioning, integrating, and implementing innovative solutions which will enhance our service delivery quality, as well as help us strategically elevate technology driven transformation for our clients. You’ll also help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for an Infrastructure Security professional with solution mindset and hands on security engineering expertise in Zero Trust Security, risk and controls concepts, architecture design. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the rollout of next generation market relevant solutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* A Security- Design & Architect professional who is responsible for designing, building, testing and implementing security within an organisation’s IT infrastructure- On Prem & Cloud.
* Professional is expected to have a thorough understanding of complex IT systems and stay up to date with the latest security standards, systems and authentication protocols, as well as best practice security products.
* Identify requirements, design document and implement technical solutions for scalable and resilient network architecture.
* Well versed with Zero Trust use cases , business & technical requirements.
* Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
* Experience in Zero-Trust and micro-segmentation solutions including Guardicore and Illumio.
* Individual should possess experience in planning, design, deployment, configuration, integration and management of network protection controls including Next gen firewalls- Palo Alto, Checkpoint, Fortinet, SDN Security, DDoS Protection, IPS, VPN, Wireless security, NAC and network authentication solutions to protect IT assets and should be responsible for deployment of any changes, plug-ins, or configuration as requested by client.
* Proven expertise in designing and delivering SASE transformations across leading platforms such as Palo Alto, Netskope, Zscaler, and Fortinet, including strategy and assessment, vendor selection, PoC validation, architecture design, and enterprise-scale implementation.
* Plan, design, deploy, configure, integrate, and manage WAF, proxy/Zscaler solutions.
* Possess hands on experience in segmenting networks, applications, and data to limit exposure to attacks.
* Plan, design, deploy, configure, integrate and manage platform protection controls including virtualisation protection solutions on Hypervisors and thin client’s security solutions.
* Good understanding of security concepts and technologies including, but not limited to TCP/IP, LDAP, DHCP, DNS, web filtering etc.
* Should be well-versed with network documentation that includes network drawings, text descriptions and equipment configurations, designing HLDs and LLDs.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Serve as highly technical security expert to bring security transformation to both new and legacy infrastructure.
* Deep technical understanding of architecture and solutioning of infrastructure security components.
* Deep knowledge of services and service delivery approach and methodology for infrastructure security including governance and operating models.
* Proven track record in building and maintaining trusted relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel and flex work timings as and when required.
* Ability to change and adapt in a hyper-growth environment.
* Self-starter and strategic thinker.
* Drive C-suite/senior leadership level meetings and discussion.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and executive presence that enable effective engagement with senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and communicate the technical and security related issues to client/business stakeholders.
* Clearly demonstrates proven extensive abilities with leveraging creative thinking and problem-solving skills, individual initiative, and utilizing Office 365, MS Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint) and Google Docs.
* Communicating in an organized and knowledgeable manner in written and verbal formats including delivering clear requests for information and communicating potential conflicts.
* Must communicate consistently and drive objectives, relying on fact-based decisions about risk that optimize the trade-off between risk mitigation and business performance.
* Good presentation, project management, facilitation and delivery skills as well as strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to create domain specific training content and deliver training effectively.
* Develop/Implement automation solutions and capabilities that are clearly aligned to client business, technology and threat posture.
* Demonstrates ability to track developments and changes in the digital business and threat environments to ensure that they're adequately addressed in client’s security strategy plans and architecture artefacts.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 6+ years of experience in Information Technology experience, with specialization in Cyber Security roles that include multiple areas of specialization. Professional-level knowledge in areas from the following:

+ Zero Trust Security Strategy and Implementation
+ Security Engineering & Architecture assessments
+ Possess understanding in firewalls, VPNs, NAC, SDWAN, WAF, Proxy, EDR/XDR etc.
+ Expert level experience with deployment, maintenance and operations of one or more major network security Devices
+ Cloud Security Architecture
+ Entrepreneurial approach to solving security problems with consultative skills
+ Well versed with Zero Trust use cases , business & technical requirements.
+ Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
+ Experience in Zero-Trust and micro-segmentation solutions including Guardicore and Illumio.
+ Individual should possess experience in planning, design, deployment, configuration, integration and management of network protection controls including Next gen firewalls- Palo Alto, Checkpoint, Fortinet, SDN Security, DDoS Protection, IPS, VPN, Wireless security, NAC and network authentication solutions to protect IT assets and should be responsible for deployment of any changes, plug-ins, or configuration as requested by client.
+ Proven expertise in designing and delivering SASE transformations across leading platforms such as Palo Alto, Netskope, Zscaler, and Fortinet, including strategy and assessment, vendor selection, PoC validation, architecture design, and enterprise-scale implementation.
+ Plan, design, deploy, configure, integrate, and manage WAF, proxy/Zscaler solutions.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good soft skills i.e. verbal & written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF, Zscaler)

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

As a
**Customer Manager – Consumer & Electronics and Mobility & Transportation**
to be located at Navi Mumbai/Bangalore and Pune, you will be responsible for driving profitable growth across strategic accounts and key market segments. You will work closely with OEMs, Tier suppliers, Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) providers and distribution partners to expand Dow's silicone solutions portfolio within Automotive, Electronics, Consumer Applications, Release Coatings, Elastomers, Railways, and other high-growth industries.

* Develop strong relationships with OEMs, Tier customers, EMS partners, distributors, and key decision-makers.

* Drive customer engagement around innovation, sustainability, localization, and new product adoption.

**Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in business administration, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Technology, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Sales, Account Management, Business Development, Technical Sales, Application Development, or Customer-Facing Commercial Roles.
* Proven track record of managing strategic customer relationships and delivering sustainable business growth.
* Strong understanding of commercial sales processes, account planning, opportunity management, and value-based selling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India to support customers and business growth initiatives.

**Preferred Experience:**
Experience in one or more of the following industries & product technology is highly desirable:
  
  

* Silicone and Specialty Chemicals
* Thermal Interface Materials
* Release coatings
* Silicone or other Elastomers.
* Electronics Materials
* EV and Mobility Solutions
* Consumer Solutions

**Your Skills:**

* Customer-focused mindset with strong problem-solving abilities
* Excellent communication and relationship-building capabilities
* Strong commercial acumen with a growth-oriented approach
* Technical aptitude and ability to learn new technologies, applications, and market trends
* Proactive approach to identifying and developing business opportunities
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
* Ability to influence stakeholders and develop long-term customer partnerships
* High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal skills when collaborating with customers and cross-functional teams

**Additional Notes:**

* Travel within India is required based on business needs.
* Relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
  
  

* Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.

+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).

+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
* Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
* Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
* On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
* Additionally, some of our locations might offer:

+ Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
+ Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)

Join our team, we can make a difference together.
  
  
**About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd**
Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science-based products and solutions in high-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
  
  
A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. The company aims to redefine the societal blueprint, by supporting holistic sustainability and circular economy initiatives.
  
  
As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. Further information regarding Dow's equal opportunities is available on www.dow.com.

**Company Description** 
 Intrelec is a long\-established provider of engineered Switchgear Panels, including MCCs, intelligent MCCs, PCCs, distribution boards, VFD and soft starter panels, as well as LV and HV busducts. Day\-to\-day tasks include reviewing tender documents, coordinating with engineering, procurement, and sales teams to gather inputs, and developing accurate cost estimates and bid documentation. The role also involves maintaining proposal templates, tracking bid status, and contributing to continuous improvement of proposal processes and tools.

* Strong skills in proposal preparation and proposal writing, including interpretation of technical specifications and tender documents.
* Solid foundation in electrical engineering, preferably with experience in switchgear panels, MCCs, PCCs, or related power distribution systems.
* Experience collaborating with sales teams, supporting pre\-sales activities, and contributing to technical presentations or client meetings.
* Exposure to procurement processes, including sourcing technical information and cost data from suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline; relevant industrial or project experience is an advantage.
* Ability to analyze technical drawings, single\-line diagrams, and equipment lists with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical information clearly.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); familiarity with ERP or bidding tools is beneficial.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple proposals and deadlines.
* Commitment to ethical, inclusive, and collaborative working practices in a diverse team environment.

* Performance tuning for existing database deployments

* Design and implement Database High Availability configurations using PostgreSQL.
* Evaluate security needs by customers and make recommendations.

* Implement backup strategies and perform upgrades and patching.
* Develop Data migration strategies to migrate large databases in line with the customer downtime constraints.
* Implement advanced Database monitoring and set up the alerts using the industry best practices and tools.


**What You Will Bring**
* 10\+ years of working experience for a professional consulting organization in the Database area with strong Database foundation skills.
* 6\+ years of direct working experience on PostgreSQL and Oracle databases
* Expertise in PostgreSQL Database implementation for high availability in large enterprise environments.

* Proficient with EDB tools
* Proficient with database tuning and use of PostgreSQL tools such as PgBadger, PEM, BARMAN
* Proficient with PostgreSQL replication technologies Streaming, Logical and Bidirectional
* Proficient with PostgreSQL architecture
* Proficient with PostgreSQL networking, HBA and connection pooling (PgBouncer, PgPool)

title: Market Development Manager
description:

 **Market Development Manager** 
 .
   

  

 This position will be based in Mumbai, India.
   

  

**As a Market Development Manager, You Will**
**Strategic Planning**
* Develop and execute short\-term and long\-term sector plans to deliver profitable growth.
* Explore new customers and markets, identify business growth opportunities, develop business cases and provide insights for business strategy formulation.
* Drive growth through new business opportunities including but not limited to new partnerships, market segments, new product applications, new business models, and chart appropriate courses of action.
* Work together with Sales team to optimize our distribution and applicator network.


**New Business Development**
* Identify, evaluate, and pursue new business opportunities across target segments, applications, and customer groups to drive profitable growth.
* Build and manage a qualified pipeline of opportunities by engaging prospective customers, partners, and key influencers in the market.
* Develop commercial proposals and business cases for new opportunities, including market potential, value proposition, competitive positioning, and implementation approach.
* Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, Innovation, and Supply Chain teams to convert identified opportunities into successful commercial outcomes.


**Project Management**
* Develop a strong understanding of market, competition, and customer needs by mapping the market, defining applications, customers, influencers, and specifiers
* Evaluate and recommend opportunities through carefully crafted business plans that consider market size, potential clients and suppliers/partners, growth opportunities, legal implications, implementation timelines and capital commitments.
* Formulate business plans for selected opportunities, identifying market potential, value propositions and cost/benefit analyses
* Manage projects until successful operational implementation and commercialization
* Work cross\-functionally, activating key business units and functions within Huntsman, partnering closely with international counterparts to develop market entry strategy for relevant global products’ smooth transition into the region.


**Portfolio Management / Innovation**
* Understand customers’ unmet needs and develop offerings, comprising products and solutions across portfolio to generate revenue and improve profitability
* Become a product and technical specialist, developing the right knowledge to solve customer problems and identify new opportunities
* Actively seek, detect and develop new business opportunities with new and existing customers to provide the right solutions
* Leverage our international success and develop customized solutions that address the unique requirements of our customers and the local market.
* Work in close collaboration with Technology \& Innovation, R\&D teams on new product opportunity identification and commercialization, providing inputs based on customer interactions, market intelligence and experience
* Monitor new technologies and trends and provide early insights for product innovation
* Understand customers' new product development roadmap and long\-term technology direction to provide inputs to Huntsman technology roadmaps and ensure differentiated positioning of our solutions.
* Monitor competitive activity in market and participate in the development and implementation of appropriate response strategies


**Value Pricing**
* Define and drive VOC (Voice of Customer) plans for the assigned sector, with a focus on developing new products / improving offerings / understanding value drivers \- manage and plan VOC requirements, identify right VOC targets for each segment, conduct VOCs and analyze VOC results
* Utilize VOC inputs to translate customer needs into CTQs and then functional requirements to develop high\-value concepts and differentiated solutions
* Implement value pricing framework for all new products and ensure target margins are achieved.
* Be accountable for new business/market development plans for the assigned sector.
* Define business plans for new market opportunities and manage projects until successful commercialization.
* Translate customers’ unmet needs into high\-value differentiated solutions.
* Understand market trends to provide timely insights for product innovation.
* Drive value pricing for new products to achieve target margins.


**What skills and experiences are we looking for?**
**Education:** 
 B.E / B.Tech \+ MBA (Marketing) from reputed institutes
   

  

**Experience**
 7\+ years’ work experience, preferably in Business / Market Development roles in technology differentiated B2B environments.
   

  

 Strong consultative selling background, with proven customer engagement and acquisition experience.
   

  

 Proven track record of leading growth projects \- defining, developing, and taking to market complex products/systems and delivering outstanding growth and profitability in B2B environments.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to work in a diverse, highly collaborative, cross\-functional work environment
   

  

**Knowledge \& Skills**
 Communication and Influencing skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Emotional maturity, good judgment and capable of communicating with a diverse range of individuals. Knows when and how to communicate to optimize potential for success with stakeholders (internal and external). Must be a good listener.
   

  

 Business Acumen: Mature business and financial acumen to discern risks/opportunities of key strategic initiatives.
   

  

 Integrative Thinker: Ability to think beyond functional priorities and assess overall business impact
   

  

 Negotiation skills: Can negotiate skilfully in tough situations, with both internal and external groups, can win concessions without damaging relationships, gains trust quickly of other parties in negotiations, able to close deals.
   

  

 Program Management: Ability to manage multiple projects on time, and provide clear verbal and written status. Must know how to effectively influence and lead others across functions, how to navigate in a matrixed environment, and how to co\-operate with other functions to deliver results without formal authority.
   

  

 Adaptability: High\-energy self\-starter, flexible to new instructions and/or dynamic organizational priorities.
   

  

 Customer Knowledge: Knowledge of customers, key players in the organization, strategic direction, etc.
   

  

 Product Knowledge: Breadth and depth of product knowledge, with ability to understand, identify and clearly articulate specific value propositions relative to competition. Ability to construct proposals, indicating system concepts and benefits
   

  

**What can we offer?**
 Huntsman offers unsurpassed opportunities to build a successful future. We are a global specialty chemical company with locations in 25 countries around the world, employing over 6,000 associates. Our diverse portfolio creates a range of career fields including manufacturing, research and development, technical services, sales and marketing, customer service – and the list goes on.
   

  

 Here, you can make an impact and make a difference. Come join us.
   

  

 Huntsman is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all qualified applicants for employment, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identification, sexual orientation and/or expression or any other characteristic protected by law in every location in which we have facilities national or local.

title: Technical Service Manager (TSM) - Maritime, Mumbai
description:
**About Us**
 We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
   

  

 As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
   

  

**About Maritime**
 We help enhance the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of our customers in the global shipping industry, covering all vessel types and mobile offshore units. As a partner to industry, we offer services in testing, certification, training, and technical advisory through the energy value chain. That means we’re continually investing heavily into R\&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Be the primary liaison for assigned Key Accounts on technical and operational matters which cannot be solved neither by DATE, nor by the Operational Centres or the surveyor network. Help the assigned Key Accounts maintain smooth technical operations and continuous vessel trade by providing personal attention, outstanding competence and added value in identifying, solving and advising the customer on those technical and operational issues in alignment with DNV’s purpose, business objectives and principles.
   

  

 The result is that you maintain and develop a trustful win\-win relationship and contribute to high customer satisfaction and loyalty which build an important foundation for DNV to maintain a high quality fleet, successfully retain existing business and secure new business.
   

  

 Team up with the relevant Key Account Manager (KAM) and work collaboratively with the Account Team and all relevant departments within DNV to ensure that excellent technical customer service levels are delivered.
   

  

 Be an important part of the Key Account Planning and Implementation process to help the KAM prepare and execute a high\-impact Key Account Plan, Account Strategy and Actions that adds value to the customer and to DNV. Provide input to the KAM on the Key Account\`s technical needs and expectations, relevant technology and regulatory developments, suitable strategies and actions related to the Key Account\`s technical issues and technical operations. Help implement the assigned actions according to plan.
   

  

 Develop and strengthen the customer relationship, operating at the Key Account\`s technical department and technical management levels, to achieve preferred supplier status based on lasting personal relationships and the added value delivered.
   

  

 Solve and advise on operational requests, customer technical concerns and technical complaints related to survey and audit performance in close collaboration with relevant technical experts and the KAM to ensure continuous vessel trade. Hand over customer requests to DATE or Operations Centres in case the requests fall into the service scope of those units.
   

  

 Systematically identify any major technical and technical operation challenges and technical concerns related to the DNV interaction with the Key Account and cascade to the KAM and to relevant departments within DNV. Follow\-up with the findings and ensure that related improvement activities are executed under utilization of the relevant DNV organization.
   

  

 Bring in foresight and help spot and resolve potential technical problems before they occur.
   

  

 Consult the customer on technical matters in meetings, presentations and workshops together or in alignment with the KAM and relevant stakeholders within DNV .
   

  

 Train, guide and consult the Key Account on rules and regulations as well as on new tools and new work processes to help them leverage the full value of our solutions and to facilitate customer's planning and implementation into operations.
   

  

 Measure and monitor the Key Account\`s performance on critical technical key performance indicators, address and support improving performance gaps by developing adequate plans and actions in alignment with the KAM and the relevant DNV organization as well as the Key Account.
   

  

 While your focus is on technical issues, remain attentive towards identifying potential business opportunities and hand those over to the KAM.
   

  

 Pro\-actively stay up to date with relevant industry, regulatory and technology trends and best practices as well as with the relevant DNV products, services, processes and tools to remain relevant towards the Key Accounts.
   

  

 Liaise with Indian flag for Flag related matters.
   

  

 Experience working with MOU’s is an added advantage.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work\-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check\-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On\-The\-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.


 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
   

  

**About You**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in the maritime/offshore industry, with exposure to ship and MOU operations, classification requirements, and customer\-facing roles.
* Driven, goal\-oriented, and results\-focused professional with a proactive approach to achieving business objectives.
* Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and stakeholders.
* Capable of performing efficiently under pressure while maintaining high standards of quality and performance.
* Forward\-thinking, innovative, and solution\-oriented, with strong analytical, decision\-making, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent customer engagement and relationship management abilities, with a proven capability to interact effectively at both operational and executive levels.
* Possesses strong knowledge of the maritime industry, offshore operations, and classification requirements.
* Experienced in ship and Mobile Offshore Unit (MOU) operations, enabling effective communication and engagement with a diverse customer base.

 As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
   

  

**The opportunity** 
 : Senior Consultant\-GOV\-Business Consulting PI\-CNS \- BC \- Transformation Delivery \- Mumbai
   

  

**GOV :**
 Our Global Government \& Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best\-in\-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
   

  

 Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
   

  

 To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re\-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross\-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
   

  

 We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head\-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
   

  

**CNS \- BC \- Transformation Delivery :**
 EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client\-centric approach focuses on driving long\-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub\-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
   

  

 Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large\-scale program and portfolio management.
   

  

 It has multiple fields of play such as:
   

  

 Finance Consulting \- helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.
   

  

 Business Transformation \- a m?ultidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem\-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi\-year, multi\-stakeholder transformation programs.
   

  

 Supply Chain and Operations \- we provide a unique combination of industry\-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations’ performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**
* Should have experience on urban planning, citizen\-centric planning, service delivery enhancement, long\-term institutional goals, monitoring of other vendors/other consultants
* Should have worked with Government (Centre/State/ULB) in India


**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**
* Bachelor of Commerce
* Bachelor of Business Administration
* Master of Technology in Civil Engineering
* Master of Engineering in Electronics
* Bachelor of Architecture
* Bachelor of Design
* Master of Commerce
* Master of Business Administration
* Master of Design


**Experience**
* Business Analysis (3\+ years)
* Product Management (4\+ years)


**What We Look For**
 People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side\-by\-side with market\-leading entrepreneurs, game\-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
   

  

 EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
   

  

 If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
   

  

 Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

title: Leasing Manager
description:
Role Description:
 



  





 Development and execution of business development strategies,
 **industrial leasing** 
 focused on both direct interactions with end\-clients and indirect sales channels (via IPCs and brokers) in the focused region, aimed at establishing strong and long\-lasting relationships with clients and channel partners.
 



 From traditional big\-box facilities to mega\-infra port\-based assets catering to global clients, and future\-ready mixed\-use developments that redefine urban last\-mile distribution, we are building new\-age assets that ensure seamless connectivity between businesses to consumers, we are redefining the future of logistics. Welspun One solves the locational needs of businesses by building best in class and innovative new age
 **Real Estate** 
 solutions.
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 




 Business Development Strategy:
 


* Formulate business development plan annually (with semi\-annual targets) in close collaboration with National Head \- Leasing.
* Collaborate with leasing support and investment teams to identify potential sectors and micro markets, product development (Mix\-Use, In\-City, etc), competitor client lease expirations, and new land purchase developments to develop a targeted BD strategy.



  





 Client identification and lead generation:
 


* Identify potential customers and regularly maintain target tracker.
* Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows to network and promote the company's services.
* Present, promote and effectively communicate company’s offerings and value proposition to prospective clients to ensure deal conversion for under construction assets by establishing a healthy active pipeline (account hunting)
* Monitor lease expiration date of existing clients \& discuss renewal options.
* Periodically review client accounts to identify areas of growth (tenant improvement/expansions) and implement strategies to maximize revenue (account farming).
* Establish and manage relationships with region focused IPCs and local brokers to capture key accounts and develop cohesive understanding of market trends.



  





 Lead Management:
 


* Periodic review of lead tracker to continually track open leads and ensure adherence towards defined follow\-up cadence.
* Maintain lead tracker on CRM platform (Zoho) for real time view of leads.



  





 Deal Qualification:
 


* Discussion of broad leasing terms (e.g., specifications, layout, etc.) with prospective clients to obtain alignment.
* Responsible for techno\-commercial discussions/ negotiations (rental rates, costing, technical requirements, etc.) to ensure deal closure at/ above IRR targets.
* Co\-ordination with prospective clients and internal teams for site visits.
* Prepare client proposals with adherence to org. policies and standards.
* Coordinate and obtain sign\-off from all internal stakeholders (projects, finance, CCO, etc.) prior to proposal submission.



  





 Transaction:
 


* Ensure all leasing documentation is accurate, complete, and compliant with company policies and legal requirements.
* Manage the lease renewal process, including negotiating terms with existing tenants and preparing renewal agreements.



  





 Key account management:
 


* Act as the Key Account Manager across project lifecycle.
* Responsible for query resolution and providing appropriate solutions to ensure customer delight (till LOI stage).
* Oversee delivery of customer satisfaction by leasing operations team from LOI to tenancy stage and facility management teams during tenancy stage; responsibility to step\-in during client escalations.



  





 MIS and reporting:
 


* Ensure effective trail management of target client list, deal movement, active pipeline records, etc. on CRM platform (Zoho).
* Provision of regular reports and updates on sales activities, client interactions, market trends, competition mapping \& their recent deal closure to senior management.



  





**Work Experience Requirements:** 



* Proven experience in business development, client management, and sales via IPCs and local brokers within the real estate sector or related industries. Good to have knowledge of the warehouse real estate sector, including market dynamics, key players, and investment trends. Experience in establishing and maintaining a network of IPCs and local brokers.
* **Target Companies:** 
 Real estate team of e\-commerce/3PL players, International Property consultants (IPC), industrial or warehousing real estate developer.

title: Manager - Global Service Provider
description:
**About The Company**
 Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
   

  

**Broad outline of the Role**
* The role owns the design and development of solution architecture with respect to technical solution design and service design for complex solutions in the respective areas of Network/SDWAN/Cloud and security/Unified Collaboration/Mobility and IoT/other domains with the objective of increasing revenue, profitability, and market competitive. This is a tactical role which defines the direction of new solutions, processes, standards based upon business strategy or customer need, with a significant mid\-term impact on business unit overall results.


**Minimum Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelors degree in engineering; 5\-8 Years relevant experience


**Other Knowledge \& Skills**
* Ability to translate customer and business requirements into technical solutions.
* Understanding on Service Provider market, Enterprise Architecture, business concepts, processes, and requirements
* Experience in creating HLD and LLD
* Developing creative, logical solutions and assisting in the presentation of findings and recommendations to clients
* Industry domain knowledge of key technology and industry trends
* Experience of delivering consulting assignments for customers in design/architecture area


**Strong Expertise In**
* Submarine cable systems
* Optical transport and DWDM technologies
* Carrier Ethernet services
* Global IP Transit and Internet services
* Internet ecosystem and peering
* Global Internet routing
* Private IP VPN solutions
* MPLS Layer 2 and Layer 3 VPN services
* International network architectures
* Carrier interconnect solutions
* SIP signalling and Voice routing.
* Service Provider Channel to Enterprise: Experience designing and positioning SD\-WAN, SASE, cloud connectivity, managed WAN, multi\-cloud networking, secure remote access, and hybrid network solutions.
* Cloud Solutions: Working knowledge of cloud services and architectures, including IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS, cloud\-native solutions, identity and secrets management, and deployment/connectivity models across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Security Solutions: Strong understanding of managed security services, DDoS protection, firewalls, SASE, secure web gateways, cloud security, zero\-trust architectures, and threat prevention and detection. Particular emphasis is placed on DDoS solution design and customer\-facing engagements.
* Unified Communications: Knowledge of cloud voice, SIP trunking, UCaaS, CCaaS, CPaaS, Voice AI, contact center solutions, and enterprise collaboration platforms.
* Mobility \& Industry Solutions: Familiarity with IoT, fleet and vehicle management, smart industry/Industry 5\.0 use cases, campus and LAN networking, and digital transformation initiatives.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Serve as a technical expert on solutions design, development, and implementation requirements to address business needs. Analyse the functionality and constraints of recommended solution across multiple systems or platforms or applications.
* Scan the technology requirements of market, participate in product development activities, represent in customer or marketing forums to increase brand awareness.
* Ensure compatibility, interoperability, stability, and usability of solution architecture.
* Design and deliver complex solutions as per customer requirements. Work with various stakeholders including sales team, products team, engineering team to jointly assess customer requirements.
* Support the Product team through the product development lifecycle and provide inputs on product features from a business requirements or customer perspective.
* Work with clients, internal stakeholders to provide integrated solution architecture across multiple products to meet the client requirements. Provide an expertise to internal teams and or or external vendors and partners to design complex solutions and ensure effective delivery of the same.
* Create and review architecture and solution design artifacts. Proactively provide guidance on engineering methodologies, standards, and best practices.
* Identify, communicate, and mitigate Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Decisions throughout complete lifecycle (Pre\-sales, Delivery, Support)
* The role may be an individual contributor or may lead a small team.

title: Associate Director - Lifesciences Partnerships
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Experience:** 
 3 – 5 years
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Department:** 
 Business Development – Life Sciences Partnerships
 



**Reports To:** 
 Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships
 



**Key Stakeholders:** 
 SVP, Life Sciences Partnerships (Business Head); Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships; Strategy and Growth Team
 








  





**About Us** 





 Qure.ai
 
 is a global healthtech company using artificial intelligence to improve disease detection and patient outcomes at scale. Our solutions are deployed across hospitals, diagnostic networks, and public health programs worldwide.
 



 Today, our technology has impacted
 **40M\+ lives** 
 across
 **105\+ countries** 
 , deployed across
 **5,200\+ sites** 
 , and powered by one of the world’s largest real\-world medical imaging datasets. With
 **26 FDA\-cleared indications** 
 , we are helping shape the future of AI\-driven healthcare.
 



  





  





**The Opportunity** 




 Qure.ai’s AI solutions are already embedded in the workflows of leading pharmaceutical companies such as AstraZeneca, Merck, Lilly and J\&J. As pharma continues to be our fastest\-growing business in the US, this is a field\-facing, high\-ownership role at the forefront of driving our next phase of growth.
 



  





 You’ll report to the Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships, who leads partnership strategy and deal development, and work closely with our Strategy and Growth Team, who support account planning, commercial collateral, and deal execution. You'll also collaborate with the SVP, Life Sciences Partnerships, who leads the business globally. In this role, you'll own the field\-building pipeline, developing strategic customer relationships, and driving opportunities from initial engagement through to successful closure.
 



 This role is designed as a high\-growth commercial path, with opportunities to take ownership of strategic accounts and grow into senior partnerships as the business scales.
 



  





 If you’re 3–5 years into a career in healthcare consulting, life sciences, digital health, or a client\-facing commercial role, and are eager to build strategic relationships, create new business opportunities, and thrive in a fast\-paced, field\-facing environment, this role is built for you.
 



  





  





**What You’ll Own \& Drive** 



* Build and manage a pipeline of pharma partnership opportunities across oncology, cardiology, respiratory and other priority therapeutic areas.
* Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders – including Medical Affairs, Market Access, Digital Health and Commercial leads \- within strategic accounts including AstraZeneca, Merck, Lilly and J\&J, while expanding into new pharma logos.
* Represent Qure.ai at industry conferences, customer meetings and life sciences events across the US \- identifying new opportunities and converting engagements into qualified pipeline.
* Partner with the Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships to shape partnership strategies and commercial opportunities by translating Qure.ai's clinical and AI capabilities into compelling value propositions.
* Collaborate closely with the Strategy and Growth team to develop account plans, proposals, presentations, and commercial collateral that support successful customer engagements.
* Own the day\-to\-day commercial execution, including prospecting, outreach, meeting cadence, CRM management, follow\-ups, forecasting, and pipeline reporting.
* Develop a strong understanding of priority disease areas, clinical workflows, and Qure.ai's AI solutions to engage credibly with physicians, scientists, and pharmaceutical stakeholders.
* Drive opportunities from initial engagement through contract execution, partnering with the Senior Director on commercial structuring, negotiations, and final approvals.








  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 Within your first 6–12 months, you will have:
 


* Built and actively managed a qualified pipeline of strategic pharmaceutical partnership opportunities, with accurate forecasting and CRM reporting.
* Represented Qure.ai at major industry conferences and customer events, establishing meaningful relationships with key stakeholders across strategic pharmaceutical accounts.
* Successfully progressed at least one partnership opportunity from initial engagement through to contract execution, in collaboration with the Senior Director, Life Sciences Partnerships.
* Developed sufficient expertise across multiple disease areas and clinical workflows to independently lead introductory customer discussions and identify partnership opportunities.
* Established yourself as a trusted commercial partner through well\-developed account plans, disciplined pipeline management, and reliable execution



  





  





**Core Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 3–5 years of experience in strategy or management consulting, healthcare, life sciences, digital health, or pharmaceutical commercial roles, or another high\-performance, client\-facing environment.
* Bachelor's degree required; an MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* Demonstrated success in building and managing client relationships, driving commercial opportunities, and delivering against commitments with a high degree of ownership.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders across pharmaceutical organizations.
* Strong analytical and learning agility, with the ability to quickly understand new disease areas, clinical workflows, and AI\-driven healthcare solutions.
* Willingness to travel extensively across the United States for customer meetings, conferences, and industry events (approximately 40% travel, if applicable).



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Prior experience working with pharmaceutical companies, healthcare providers, or life sciences organizations.
* Exposure to Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, or Digital Health functions within the pharmaceutical industry.
* Experience selling or partnering around healthcare technology, SaaS, AI, diagnostics, or digital health solutions.

title: Member of Applied AI -Architect { Mumbai}
description:
**About DevRev**
 At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
 *Computer* 
 – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
 *Computer* 
 unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI\-ready platform, giving employees real\-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI\-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human\-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M\+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Forward Deployment Architect, you will serve as
 **a hands\-on senior technical architect** 
 on the Applied AI Engineering team, owning the end\-to\-end design and delivery of AI\-driven business transformation projects.
   

  

 You'll work closely with pre\-sales teams to scope technical integration and implementation strategies, translating business requirements into architectural solutions. Once opportunities move to post\-sales, you'll own the detailed technical designs from original scoping documents and drive execution including hands\-on coding to build proofs\-of\-concept, custom integrations, and solution prototypes that validate technical feasibility.
   

  

 As the technical owner of the customer relationship, you'll partner cross\-collaboratively to ensure successful delivery. Your role spans from understanding domain\-specific customer needs to architecting scalable, agent\-based AI solutions using DevRev's platform\*\*, with direct involvement in implementing key technical components and debugging complex integration challenges.
   

  

 This position requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture expertise, AI solution design, hands\-on development skills, customer empathy, and cross\-functional collaboration. You'll act as the connective tissue between pre\-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams, bringing our AI capabilities to life for real\-world business impact.
   

  

**What You'll Do**

title: Business Continuity Manager @ Mumbai
description:
We are seeking a knowledgeable and client\-focused
 **Cybersecurity GRC Consultant** 
 to support consulting, assessment, audit, compliance, and documentation engagements across information security, privacy, regulatory compliance, third\-party risk, and cyber resilience. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience delivering cybersecurity GRC engagements for clients, interpreting regulatory requirements, conducting maturity and posture assessments, and preparing high\-quality client\-facing reports, policies, and remediation roadmaps.
 



**Role Overview** 




 The Cybersecurity GRC Consultant will work with clients across industries to assess, design, implement, and improve cybersecurity governance, risk, compliance, privacy, and resilience programs. The role requires strong consulting capability, audit experience, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate technical and regulatory requirements into actionable business controls.
 



 The consultant will contribute to engagements involving ISO standards, NIST\-based assessments, Indian financial\-sector regulations, privacy compliance, third\-party risk management, cyber risk assessment, policy development, awareness programs, and audit readiness.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Conduct cybersecurity GRC consulting, assessment, audit, and advisory engagements for client organizations.
* Perform ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS gap assessments, internal audits, implementation support, risk assessments, control reviews, and certification\-readiness activities.
* Support business continuity and resilience engagements aligned with ISO 22301, including BCMS documentation, business impact analysis, risk assessment, continuity planning, and exercise support.
* Conduct cybersecurity posture assessments, maturity assessments, control effectiveness reviews, and compliance gap assessments.
* Assess client environments against relevant frameworks and standards, including:
* ISO/IEC 27001:2022
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework and related NIST guidance
* SOC 2 Type II requirements
* Data Protection and Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDPA) requirements
* General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
* Data privacy principles, privacy governance, and privacy\-by\-design requirements
* RBI cybersecurity, IT governance, outsourcing, digital\-payment, and related regulatory requirements
* SEBI cybersecurity and cyber\-resilience requirements
* IRDAI cybersecurity, information security, and related regulatory requirements
* Lead or support cyber risk management activities, including risk identification, control mapping, risk scoring, treatment planning, risk\-register maintenance, and management reporting.
* Conduct Third\-Party Risk Management (TPRM) assessments, including vendor due diligence, cybersecurity questionnaires, risk evaluation, contractual security requirements, and remediation tracking.
* Support SOC 2 Type II readiness reviews, control design assessments, evidence reviews, and ongoing compliance monitoring.
* Develop, review, and enhance cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, guidelines, frameworks, registers, and process documentation.
* Prepare client deliverables such as assessment reports, audit reports, gap\-analysis reports, compliance matrices, risk registers, remediation roadmaps, executive presentations, and management dashboards.
* Conduct cybersecurity awareness and training programs for employees, management, and relevant stakeholders.
* Facilitate client workshops, interviews, walkthroughs, evidence reviews, risk discussions, and leadership presentations.
* Track observations, nonconformities, risks, action plans, and closure evidence through the engagement lifecycle.
* Collaborate with technical, legal, privacy, business, audit, and compliance stakeholders to ensure practical implementation of cybersecurity controls.
* Keep abreast of evolving cybersecurity regulations, privacy requirements, threat trends, and industry best practices.
* Contribute to proposal development, scoping, pre\-sales discussions, statements of work, and client presentations where required.



**Required Experience and Skills** 



* 5–6 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity GRC consulting, information security consulting, IT audit, risk advisory, compliance, or related roles.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with clients in a consulting, advisory, audit, or assurance capacity.
* Hands\-on experience in ISO/IEC 27001 implementation, gap assessment, internal audit, risk assessment, control documentation, or certification\-readiness engagements.
* Strong understanding of NIST cybersecurity frameworks and their practical application in assessment and improvement programs.

title: Founder office
description:
About the role
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership seat next to the founder of a fast\-growing AI marketing company working in Generative Engine Optimisation — the discipline of making brands the answer that AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude give when people ask a question.
 



  





 The category is roughly three years old. We work with listed companies, hospitals, defence manufacturers, luxury houses, law firms and global consumer brands across India, the US and Southeast Asia. There is no established playbook, which is exactly what makes this interesting.
 



  





 You will not have a narrow job description. You'll work on whatever is most important that week — which could be a client proposal on Monday, a hiring process on Wednesday and a pricing model on Friday.
 



  





 What you'll actually do
 



  





 • Client strategy and proposals — research prospects, build audits and scope documents, and prepare the commercial proposals the founder takes into rooms
 



 • Business development support — prepare for pitches, handle follow\-ups, and manage the pipeline so nothing goes cold
 



 • Special projects — new product definition, market research, partnership evaluation, pricing structures
 



 • Internal systems — help build the processes, templates and trackers that let delivery scale without breaking
 



 • Hiring and team building — draft roles, screen candidates, run first\-round conversations
 



 • Meeting follow\-through — capture what was decided, convert it into actions, and make sure those actions actually close
 



 • Anything else that needs an owner — genuinely
 



  





 What we're looking for
 



  





 • 2–5 years of experience — consulting, investment banking, startup operations, strategy, or a founder's office elsewhere. Strong recent graduates from top institutions with real internship depth will also be considered
 



 • Exceptional written English. You will write a great deal — proposals, emails, documents that go to CXOs of large companies
 



 • Structured thinking. You can take something ambiguous and turn it into a clear plan
 



 • Genuine research ability. You check facts, notice when two sources disagree, and don't assume
 



 • Comfort with ambiguity and pace. Priorities shift; you need to be the kind of person who finds that energising rather than destabilising
 



 • Real ownership instinct. Nobody will chase you. Things you own should close
 



  





 What will make you stand out
 



  





 • Hands\-on familiarity with AI tools as working instruments, not novelties
 



 • Exposure to B2B sales, agency or consulting environments
 



 • Financial literacy — you can build a pricing model or read a company's results
 



 • Experience working directly with senior leadership
 



  





 What this job is not
 



  





 • It is not a coordination or note\-taking role. You'll be expected to have views and defend them
 



 • It is not narrowly defined. If you need a fixed remit to do your best work, this will frustrate you
 



 • It is not a comfortable 10\-to\-6\. The pace is real, and so is the learning
 



  





 Why take it
 



  





 You'll sit at the centre of a company in a category that barely exists yet, with unusual visibility into how clients are won, priced and kept. The exposure is far broader than an equivalent\-level role at a larger firm — you'll see the whole business rather than one function of it.
 



  





 For the right person, this is a role that compounds quickly.
 



  





 To apply: send your CV and a short note — no more than half a page — on something you owned end\-to\-end and what you'd do differently, to abhay@connectify.global

Excellent skills in PowerPoint and Excel are expected. Experience managing projects, developing client relationships and contributing to business development is highly valued.

 To be eligible for this position, candidates must hold Indian citizenship or possess a valid work permit for India.

title: Founders office
description:
Founder’s Office – Strategy, Business Development \& Operations
 



  





 KS Legal \& Associates \| Mumbai
 



  





 About the Role
 



  





 KS Legal is looking for a highly driven, sharp and entrepreneurial individual to work directly with the Founder as part of the Founder’s Office.
 



  





 This is not a conventional desk job. We are looking for someone who can operate as an extension of the Founder someone who can think independently, manage people, build relationships, drive business, represent the firm professionally and take ownership of whatever needs to get done.
 



  





 The role will involve working across strategy, operations, client management, business development, PR, networking, presentations, research and special projects.
 



  





 You should be comfortable moving between a client meeting, a team discussion, a pitch presentation, a networking event and an internal operational issue and be able to handle each with confidence.
 



  





 What You Will Do
 



  





 1\. Founder’s Office \& Execution
 



  





 \* Work closely with the Founder on day\-to\-day strategic and operational priorities.
 



 \* Convert the Founder’s ideas and discussions into actionable tasks and ensure timely execution.
 



 \* Follow up with internal teams, clients, external stakeholders and vendors.
 



 \* Manage multiple priorities simultaneously and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
 



 \* Identify problems independently and find solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
 



 \* Prepare briefs, reports, trackers, presentations and updates for the Founder.
 



 \* Assist with special projects and initiatives undertaken by the firm.
 



  





 2\. Team Management
 



  





 \* Coordinate and manage different teams and workstreams.
 



 \* Allocate and follow up on tasks and monitor timelines.
 



 \* Ensure accountability and execution across the team.
 



 \* Identify bottlenecks and escalate important issues to the Founder.
 



 \* Help create systems, processes and workflows to improve the firm’s efficiency.
 



 \* Maintain discipline around deadlines, deliverables and follow\-ups.
 



  





 3\. Business Development \& Client Acquisition
 



  





 \* Identify and develop potential clients and business opportunities.
 



 \* Build and maintain relationships with founders, promoters, CXOs, investors, professionals, companies and other relevant stakeholders.
 



 \* Assist in converting relationships and conversations into mandates.
 



 \* Research prospective clients and understand their business and legal requirements.
 



 \* Participate in client meetings and business discussions.
 



 \* Prepare pitches, proposals, credentials and presentations.
 



 \* Follow up on leads, proposals and prospective mandates.
 



 \* Develop new channels for business generation and strategic partnerships.
 



 \* Represent KS Legal at networking events, conferences and industry forums.
 



  





 4\. Client Relationship Management
 



  





 \* Maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
 



 \* Understand client requirements and coordinate internally to ensure effective delivery.
 



 \* Track important client conversations, follow\-ups and opportunities.
 



 \* Ensure a high\-quality client experience.
 



 \* Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships.
 



  





 5\. PR, Media \& Brand Building
 



  





 \* Work with the Founder and external/internal PR teams on the firm’s positioning and visibility.
 



 \* Identify relevant media opportunities, publications, interviews, panels and speaking opportunities.
 



 \* Assist with journalist outreach and PR pitching.
 



 \* Coordinate thought\-leadership opportunities for the Founder and the firm.
 



 \* Help develop content, presentations, articles, opinions and other external communications.
 



 \* Track relevant industry conversations and identify opportunities for KS Legal to participate.
 



  





 6\. Presentations \& Communication
 



  





 \* Create high\-quality presentations, pitch decks, business proposals and internal presentations.
 



 \* Assist the Founder in preparing for important meetings, pitches and speaking engagements.
 



 \* Develop clear and compelling written and verbal communication for clients and external stakeholders.
 



 \* Present confidently when required.
 



  





 7\. Research \& Strategic Projects
 



  





 \* Conduct business, industry, competitor and market research.
 



 \* Track developments relevant to the firm’s practice areas and clients.
 



 \* Identify new sectors, industries and opportunities for the firm.
 



 \* Assist in developing new practice areas, initiatives and business strategies.
 



 \* Prepare concise research notes and actionable insights for the Founder.
 



  





 8\. Travel \& External Representation
 



  





 \* Travel with the Founder or independently for client meetings, conferences, networking events and business development initiatives, as required.
 



 \* Represent KS Legal professionally in meetings and external events.
 



 \* Coordinate logistics and preparation for meetings, events and travel.
 



  





 What We Are Looking For
 



  





 We are looking for an owner, not an order\-taker.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will be:
 



  





 \* Highly proactive and self\-driven.
 



 \* Extremely organised and excellent at follow\-ups.
 



 \* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced and demanding environment.
 



 \* Strong in communication, presentation and relationship\-building.
 



 \* Commercially aware and interested in business development.
 



 \* Confident interacting with senior professionals, founders, CXOs and clients.
 



 \* Comfortable managing teams and holding people accountable.
 



 \* Excellent at preparing presentations and written material.
 



 \* Comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities.
 



 \* Someone who can independently take a problem, figure out what needs to be done and execute it.
 



 \* Presentable, professional and confident in external interactions.
 



 \* Willing to travel and attend meetings/events when required.
 



 \* Someone who genuinely enjoys networking, meeting people and building relationships.
 



  





 The Most Important Quality
 



  





 You should not need to be told what to do at every step.
 



  





 If the Founder says, “We should explore this client / event / opportunity,” you should be able to research it, identify the right people, initiate contact, prepare the pitch, coordinate the meeting, follow up and report back — without needing instructions for every individual step.
 



  





 Who This Role Is For
 



  





 This role would suit someone who wants exposure to business, law, entrepreneurship, strategy, leadership and client management rather than being restricted to one functional role.
 



  





 You will work closely with the Founder and get a first\-hand view of how a professional services business is built, managed and scaled.
 



  





 Experience
 



  





 Any level of experience preferred, although exceptional candidates from consulting, business development, startups, professional services, PR, strategy, law or similar backgrounds may be considered.
 



  





 A legal background is not mandatory.
 



  





 What matters more is intelligence, ownership, communication, commercial instinct, execution ability and the ability to build relationships.
 



  





 Location
 



  





 Mumbai
 



  





 The role will involve regular interaction with the Founder, team members, clients and external stakeholders, along with travel and attendance at meetings/events as required.
 



  





 What We Expect
 



  





 \* High ownership
 



 \* Strong work ethic
 



 \* Excellent follow\-through
 



 \* Confidentiality and discretion
 



 \* Professionalism
 



 \* Attention to detail
 



 \* Speed of execution
 



 \* Ability to prioritise
 



 \* Strong relationship\-building skills
 



 \* Willingness to do whatever is required to get the job done
 



  





 What You Can Expect
 



  





 \* Direct exposure to the Founder and leadership of the firm.
 



 \* Significant responsibility and autonomy.
 



 \* Exposure to high\-value clients and business relationships.
 



 \* Opportunity to participate in business development, strategy, PR and growth initiatives.
 



 \* A fast\-learning environment with substantial ownership.
 



 \* Opportunity to grow into a senior leadership/business role within the organisation.
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who wants to build, not simply execute a job description.

title: Partner Success
